summary_cn: 根据泰国金商协会最新公布，2026年9月14日的黄金价格保持稳定。纯金金条价格为每克拉68,250泰铢，黄金饰品价格为每克拉69,050泰铢，一斯隆（八分之一两）饰金价格为17,063泰铢。金价市场今日平稳无明显波动。

desc: รัฐบาลอุดช่อง ป้องกันธุรกิจรายใหญ่ประวิงชำระค่าสินค้ายื้อจ่าย SME รื้อกติกาเครดิตเทอม จ่ายให้เกษตรไม่เกิน 30 วัน–การค้า ผลิต บริการ 45 วัน
title_cn: 泰国政府调整中小企业信用期限防止大企业拖欠
summary_cn: 泰国政府推出新政策支持中小企业（SME），防止大型企业滥用延期付款手段。新规定明确农产品交易信用期最长30天，商业、制造业和服务业最长45天。这一改革旨在保护中小企业的现金流，创造更公平的商业竞争环境。
desc_original: รัฐบาลอุดช่อง ป้องกันธุรกิจรายใหญ่ประวิงชำระค่าสินค้ายื้อจ่าย SME รื้อกติกาเครดิตเทอม จ่ายให้เกษตรไม่เกิน 30 วัน–การค้า ผลิต บริการ 45 วัน

desc: CHERY GROUP ดันเทคโนโลยี REEV ชูจุดเด่นขับเคลื่อนด้วยมอเตอร์ไฟฟ้าเครื่องยนต์ปั่นไฟไม่ต้องรอคิวชาร์จ ส่ง JAECOO 6T และ iCAR V27 REEV ออฟโรดทรงกล่องพลัง 400+ ม้า ลุยไกลทะลุ 1,000 กม.
title_cn: 奇瑞新能源越野车 REEV 技术对比实测
summary_cn: 奇瑞集团推广 REEV（纯电驱动加汽油增程）技术，旗下 JAECOO 6T 和 iCAR V27 两款越野车型采用该技术。这些车型搭载电动马达和汽油发电机相结合的动力系统，无需排队充电，总功率超400匹马力，综合续航能力超过1,000公里。

title: รัฐบาลดัน “KKUVOLT” แบตเตอรี่ มข. จากงานวิจัยสู่ตลาดจริง ปูทางอุตสาหกรรมพลังงานใหม่ของไทย
desc: อว. โชว์ผลสำเร็จ KKUVOLT ต่อยอดองค์ความรู้แบตเตอรี่ มข. นับ 10 ปี สู่ผลิตภัณฑ์จริง ตั้งแต่แบตเตอรี่รถ EV ระบบโซลาร์เซลล์ ถึงระบบกักเก็บพลังงาน BESS พร้อมปั้นกำลังคนรับอุตสาหกรรมพลังงานอนาคต
title_cn: 政府推动「KKUVOLT」电池产业化——将朱拉隆功大学研究成果转化为市场产品，打造泰国新能源产业之路
summary_cn: 泰国能源部展示 KKUVOLT 电池研发成果，将朱拉隆功大学十年的电池研究转化为实际产品，涵盖电动车电池、太阳能电池系统及 BESS 储能系统等。同时培育人才队伍，为泰国未来能源产业提供支撑。该项目标志着研究端向产业端的重要转变。

title: Analysts counsel balance in devising platform regulation
desc: Thailand needs stronger oversight of increasingly powerful digital platforms, but regulators should avoid setting overlapping rules and premature restrictions that could stifle competition and innovation, according to platform operators, competition law specialists and academics.
title_cn: 专家呼吁数字平台监管需平衡——避免重复规则影响创新竞争
summary_cn: 业界人士和法律专家认为，泰国需加强数字平台的监管力度，但监管机构应避免设置相互重叠的规则和过度限制，以免阻碍市场竞争和技术创新。该观点反映出监管力度与商业环境之间需要找到平衡点。
desc_original: Thailand needs stronger oversight of increasingly powerful digital platforms, but regulators should avoid setting overlapping rules and premature restrictions that could stifle competition and innovation, according to platform operators, competition law specialists and academics.

title: AIS: AI outlays must match effort
desc: Thailand's AI challenge is no longer about gaining access to technology, but rather ensuring people and organisations have the capabilities to use it to its full potential, says Advanced Info Service (AIS).
title_cn: AIS：泰国AI建设投入应与人才能力提升相适应
summary_cn: 泰国高级信息服务公司（AIS）认为，泰国当前面临的人工智能挑战已超越单纯的技术获取层面，关键在于确保全社会企业、组织及个人拥有充分的专业能力，从而有效利用AI技术释放其在经济发展、产业升级中的巨大潜力。这反映了泰国发展数字经济的当务之急。
desc_original: Thailand's AI challenge is no longer about gaining access to technology, but rather ensuring people and organisations have the capabilities to use it to its full potential, says Advanced Info Service (AIS).

title: Indonesia issues new halal rules
desc: The Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP) is urging businesses to prepare for Indonesia's new halal regulations, set to take effect on Oct 18.
title_cn: 印度尼西亚发布新清真认证规则 泰企需及时调适
summary_cn: 泰国国际贸易促进部（DITP）正敦促国内出口企业为邻国印度尼西亚颁布的新清真认证规定做好充分准备，该新规将于10月18日正式生效。这一新规对出口至印尼或在当地开展业务的泰国食品、日用品及相关企业具有重要影响，需要尽快调整认证流程以符合新的合规要求。
desc_original: The Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP) is urging businesses to prepare for Indonesia's new halal regulations, set to take effect on Oct 18.

title: คลังนัดเคลียร์วัดทั่วประเทศ สรรพากรนัดถก “อี-โดเนชัน” ป้องกันยักยอก
desc: สรรพากร นัดถก พศ 22 ก.ย.นี้ เร่งเคลียร์วัดทั่วประเทศ เข้าใจระบบภาษี และอี-โดเนชัน ป้องกันยักยอก
title_cn: 泰国税务部推进寺庙记账清理 研讨电子捐赠制度防逃税
summary_cn: 泰国税务部门定于9月22日召开专题会议，推动全国佛教庙宇的财务清账工作，同时深入研讨「电子捐赠」系统建设方案。电子化管理旨在规范和透明化寺庙慈善捐献流程，增强税收管理的科学性和防控能力，有效防止逃税漏税现象。这体现了泰国在财税现代化和宗教事务管理方面的新探索。
desc_original: สรรพากร นัดถก พศ 22 ก.ย.นี้ เร่งเคลียร์วัดทั่วประเทศ เข้าใจระบบภาษี และอี-โดเนชัน ป้องกันยักยอก

title: Govt clarifies aid to Cambodia
desc: Government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises on Sunday denied Thailand had approved a new 31-million-baht aid project for Cambodia, saying the actual allocation is 18.2 million baht to cover interest payments on two previously completed infrastructure projects.
title_cn: 泰政府澄清对柬埔寨援助金额
summary_cn: 泰国政府发言人艾卡波周日否认批准向柬埔寨新增援助项目，称实际分配为1820万泰铢，用于支付两个已完成基础设施项目的利息，以澄清此前的误解。
desc_original: Government spokesman Ekkapob Pianpises on Sunday denied Thailand had approved a new 31-million-baht aid project for Cambodia, saying the actual allocation is 18.2 million baht to cover interest payments on two previously completed infrastructure projects.

title: Wellness push merges tradition and technology
desc: The government is initiating an ambitious plan to transform the nation's medical sector into a revenue driver and economic growth engine.
title_cn: 泰国医疗健康产业融合传统与技术
summary_cn: 泰政府启动雄心勃勃的计划，将医疗部门转型为重要的收入驱动力和经济增长引擎，利用传统医学与现代技术融合的优势，打造国家新的经济增长点。
desc_original: The government is initiating an ambitious plan to transform the nation's medical sector into a revenue driver and economic growth engine.

title: Agency steps up digital trust efforts
desc: The Electronic Transactions Development Agency (Etda) has identified digital platform oversight, digital ID, artificial intelligence (AI) governance and digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises as four major areas of focus for 2027 as it moves to strengthen digital trust in Thailand.
title_cn: 泰国电子交易发展局加强数字信任建设
summary_cn: 泰国电子交易发展局（ETDA）确定了2027年四大重点工作：数字平台监管、数字身份认证、人工智能治理及中小企业数字转型，旨在强化泰国整体的数字生态信任体系。
desc_original: The Electronic Transactions Development Agency (Etda) has identified digital platform oversight, digital ID, artificial intelligence (AI) governance and digital transformation of small and medium-sized enterprises as four major areas of focus for 2027 as it moves to strengthen digital trust in Thailand.

title: High costs hinder concert segment
desc: Although concerts have been a major driver of tourism and hotel occupancy in many destinations, including Thailand, concertgoers still regard high costs as the biggest obstacle.
title_cn: 高票价成演唱会旅游的主要障碍
summary_cn: 演唱会在泰国等地已成为旅游和酒店业的重要驱动力，但高成本仍是观众参与的最大阻碍，如何平衡票价与市场需求成为行业关键课题。
desc_original: Although concerts have been a major driver of tourism and hotel occupancy in many destinations, including Thailand, concertgoers still regard high costs as the biggest obstacle.

title: Ministry considers golden share rights
desc: The Finance Ministry has moved forward with a study of the conditions for exercising golden share rights in companies where the state holds a minority stake.
title_cn: 泰国财政部研究黄金股权运用条件
summary_cn: 泰国财政部推进对黄金股权行使条件的研究，以便在国有少数股权企业中更有效地行使政府权利，加强对战略性产业的控制力。
desc_original: The Finance Ministry has moved forward with a study of the conditions for exercising golden share rights in companies where the state holds a minority stake.

title: Pressure is mounting
desc: In less than six months in power, the Bhumjaithai Party-led government has faced numerous political and economic challenges.
title_cn: 压力升温
summary_cn: 英俊党(Bhumjaithai)领导的泰国政府自上台以来不足半年，已面临多项政治与经济挑战，政治压力明显升温。这些挑战包括来自国内多方面的压力，政治稳定性受到考验。作为执政党之一，英俊党需要在复杂的政治环境中维持政府运作的同时，应对经济方面的压力，包括民众对经济政策的期待与挑战。
desc_original: In less than six months in power, the Bhumjaithai Party-led government has faced numerous political and economic challenges.

title: Drive bolstered to make online traders pay tax
desc: The Revenue Department is stepping up efforts to bring online traders into the tax system after successfully adding more than 56,000 operators to the system last year.
title_cn: 税收部门加强网络商户征税
summary_cn: 泰国税务部(Revenue Department)继去年成功登记超过56000家在线商户后，正加大力度继续将网络商户纳入税收管理系统。此举旨在扩大税收基础、提高征收效率，确保网络经济的税收规范性。在电商经济快速发展的背景下，政府加强对在线商户的税收监管，对维护市场公平竞争具有重要意义。
desc_original: The Revenue Department is stepping up efforts to bring online traders into the tax system after successfully adding more than 56,000 operators to the system last year.

title: Govt rejects reports of monthly firearm licence renewals
desc: The government on Sunday rejected reports that gun owners would have to renew their licences and pay fees every one to two months, saying the claim was not in line with proposed measures to improve firearms control.
title_cn: 政府否认枪支证每月续期报道
summary_cn: 泰国政府日前否认枪支持证人需要每一至两个月续期并缴费的报道，强调这一说法与政府拟议的枪支管制改革方案不符。政府澄清，相关改革的目的是加强枪支管制，而非增加枪支持有人的经济负担。此项声明旨在消除公众对枪支政策调整的误解，维护政府的政策信誉。
desc_original: The government on Sunday rejected reports that gun owners would have to renew their licences and pay fees every one to two months, saying the claim was not in line with proposed measures to improve firearms control.

title: PM instructs Ekniti to extend relief
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has told Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas to consider extending the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme by one to two months.
title_cn: 总理指示延长「泰人援泰加强版」救济计划
summary_cn: 泰国总理阿努廷(Anutin Charnvirakul)指示副总理兼财政部长艾克尼蒂(Ekniti Nitithanprapas)研究延长「泰人援泰加强版」(Thais Help Thais Plus)救济计划一至两个月的可行性。该救济计划是政府为缓解民众经济压力而推出的重要政策，延长期限将进一步惠及受困民众，体现政府对基层民众生活的关切与支持。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has told Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas to consider extending the "Thais Help Thais Plus" scheme by one to two months.

title: PM's Office rejects Wang Tanod forest allegation
desc: The Prime Minister's Office has rejected claims by veteran commentator Sondhi Limthongkul that cabinet approval of the Wang Tanod reservoir in Chanthaburi amounts to ordering forest destruction.
title_cn: 总理办公室否认翁坦水库毁林指控
summary_cn: 泰国总理办公室否认资深评论员宋迪(Sondhi Limthongkul)关于政府批准尖竹汶府(Chanthaburi)翁坦水库(Wang Tanod)项目的指控。宋迪声称内阁批准该项目等同于下令摧毁森林，但总理办公室澄清，该项目符合环保与水资源管理的相关规定。此项声明反映了环保议题在泰国的重要性，以及政府对环保关切的重视。
desc_original: The Prime Minister's Office has rejected claims by veteran commentator Sondhi Limthongkul that cabinet approval of the Wang Tanod reservoir in Chanthaburi amounts to ordering forest destruction.

title: Tensions rise over Israeli expats
desc: Tensions have heightened in recent months over the presence of Israeli communities in various parts of the country, raising questions about nominee arrangements and land holdings involving Israelis.
title_cn: 以色列侨民社区引发紧张局势
summary_cn: 近月来以色列社群在泰国各地聚居引发社会紧张气氛，引起人们对代理人安排和以色列人土地产权等敏感问题的广泛关注。
desc_original: Tensions have heightened in recent months over the presence of Israeli communities in various parts of the country, raising questions about nominee arrangements and land holdings involving Israelis.

title: EC poised to show its cards
desc: The Senate election collusion case is entering a crucial stage, with the Election Commission (EC) set to decide on Monday whether to petition the Supreme Court's Election Cases Division against those accused.
title_cn: 选举委员会参议院舞弊案将迎决关时刻
summary_cn: 参议院选举贿选案进入关键阶段，选举委员会(EC)将于周一决定是否向最高法院选举案件庭对被指控人士提起诉讼。
desc_original: The Senate election collusion case is entering a crucial stage, with the Election Commission (EC) set to decide on Monday whether to petition the Supreme Court's Election Cases Division against those accused.

title: Army pledges to assist probe  into conscript's death in camp
desc: The 2nd Army Region has pledged to cooperate fully with police and other authorities in an investigation into the death of a 20-year-old conscript found hanging from a tree at a military camp in Nakhon Ratchasima.
title_cn: 军方承诺全力配合新兵营内死亡事件调查
summary_cn: 第2军区承诺与警方和有关部门全面配合，调查一名20岁义务兵在那空叻差西玛(Nakhon Ratchasima)军营内上吊身亡事件。
desc_original: The 2nd Army Region has pledged to cooperate fully with police and other authorities in an investigation into the death of a 20-year-old conscript found hanging from a tree at a military camp in Nakhon Ratchasima.

title: EA shifts focus from debt to growth
desc: Energy Absolute Plc (EA) says it has overcome the most critical phase of its financial crisis after restructuring its debt and strengthening its balance sheet, allowing the renewable energy company to pursue new growth opportunities.
title_cn: 能源绝对公司重组后转向增长战略
summary_cn: 可再生能源企业能源绝对公司(EA)表示已度过财务危机最严峻阶段，通过债务重组和资产负债表加强，现可开拓新的增长机遇。
desc_original: Energy Absolute Plc (EA) says it has overcome the most critical phase of its financial crisis after restructuring its debt and strengthening its balance sheet, allowing the renewable energy company to pursue new growth opportunities.

title: Epac extends diesel refinery price cut policy
desc: The Energy Policy Administration Committee (Epac) has extended a measure cutting the refinery price of high-speed diesel by 2.40 baht per litre from Wednesday to Oct 31, says the Royal Gazette.
title_cn: 能委会延期高速柴油降价政策至10月底
summary_cn: 能源政策行政委员会(Epac)将高速柴油炼厂降价政策延期至10月31日，降幅维持每升2.40泰铢，相关决议已刊登《皇家公报》。
desc_original: The Energy Policy Administration Committee (Epac) has extended a measure cutting the refinery price of high-speed diesel by 2.40 baht per litre from Wednesday to Oct 31, says the Royal Gazette.

title: PP tells Pheu Thai to act on graft
desc: People's Party (PP) deputy leader Wiroj Lakkhanaadisorn has accused Pheu Thai Party senior figure Phumtham Wechayachai of using past political disagreements as a pretext to abandon anti-corruption principles.
title_cn: 人民党促为泰党严肃对待反腐问题
summary_cn: 人民党（PP）副领导人威罗吉·拉克哈纳迪颂（Wiroj Lakkhanaadisorn）指控为泰党资深人物普塔玛·维查亚差（Phumtham Wechayachai）以往政治分歧为借口，放弃反腐原则。这一公开指责凸显泰国主要政党在廉政立场上的新矛盾，引发外界对执政联盟稳定性的关注。
desc_original: People's Party (PP) deputy leader Wiroj Lakkhanaadisorn has accused Pheu Thai Party senior figure Phumtham Wechayachai of using past political disagreements as a pretext to abandon anti-corruption principles.

desc: Taylor’s Schools enters Thailand as St. Andrews International School joins the group Legacy Taylor’s Schools, one of Southeast Asia’s leading K-12 education groups, has entered Thailand through the transition of St. Andrews International School into the group. It includes four St. Andrews campuses: Sathorn, Dusit and Sukhumvit 107 in Bangkok, and Green Valley on Thailand’s Eastern Seaboard. title_cn: 泰勒教育集团进军泰国，圣安德鲁斯学校加入
summary_cn: 东南亚领先K-12教育集团泰勒学校（Taylor's Schools）通过收购圣安德鲁斯国际学校进入泰国市场，首次扩展至马来西亚和新加坡之外。泰国共四所圣安德鲁斯校园加入，分别位于曼谷沙通（Sathorn）、都实（Dusit）、素坤逸107路段（Sukhumvit 107）及东海岸格林谷（Green Valley），各校保留原名和师资，同时获得集团的资源支持和专业发展机会。

desc: “เจเศรษฐ์” ลงพื้นติดตามเหตุเพลิงไหม้ภายในอาคารเฉลิมพระเกียรติ บ้านแพ้ว สั่ง ปภ.-โยธาฯ ตรวจโครงสร้างด่วนก่อนเปิดใช้ ชื่นชมแผนอพยพไว
title_cn: 高层官员督导火灾现场，命令检查结构安全
summary_cn: 泰国政府高级官员赴现场视察建筑火灾事件，随后下令警察和工程部门在重新启用前进行紧急结构检查。官员对现有应急疏散预案表示高度认可，强调预案准备的及时性和有效性。此举反映了泰国政府在应对公共设施安全问题时的重视态度和快速反应机制。

title: Cafeteria ceiling collapses at costly parliament complex
desc: A section of ceiling collapsed in a basement cafeteria at the multi-billion-baht parliament complex on Sunday, breaking tables and toppling chairs but fortunately causing no injuries because it was not a working day.
title_cn: 国会大楼食堂天花板突然坍塌
summary_cn: 泰国耗资数十亿铢新建的国会综合体周日发生结构事故——地下室食堂天花板坍塌，砸毁用餐设施和家具。幸运的是事发时非工作日，未造成人员伤亡。该事件再次引发外界对这座新型议会建筑工程质量的严重质疑，凸显了泰国大型基础设施项目在施工标准和维护方面需要改进的问题。
desc_original: A section of ceiling collapsed in a basement cafeteria at the multi-billion-baht parliament complex on Sunday, breaking tables and toppling chairs but fortunately causing no injuries because it was not a working day.

title: Actress links threat to her testifying about Tangmo's death
desc: Actress Usamanee “Kwan” Waitayanon has told police she was threatened on Sunday morning, saying it might be related to her decision to give witness testimony in the death of actress Nida “Tangmo” Patcharaveerapong, who fell from a speedboat on the Chao Phraya River in 2022.
title_cn: 女演员声称遭威胁与唐默案作证有关
summary_cn: 泰国女演员乌莎玛妮·维塔亚农（Usamanee Waitayanon）向警方报案称周日上午收到威胁信息，怀疑与自己决定在昭披耶河快艇坠亡案中作证有关。该案受害者为知名女演员妮达·唐默·帕查瑞维拉蓬（Nida Tangmo Patcharaveerapong），于2022年快艇坠河身亡。威胁事件进一步凸显该悬案的敏感程度，也映射了泰国刑事司法中证人保护的困难。
desc_original: Actress Usamanee “Kwan” Waitayanon has told police she was threatened on Sunday morning, saying it might be related to her decision to give witness testimony in the death of actress Nida “Tangmo” Patcharaveerapong, who fell from a speedboat on the Chao Phraya River in 2022.

title: Marchers demand mass prosecutions in senate collusion case
desc: Supporters of Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) marched 11-kilometres through Bangkok on Sunday demanding the Election Commission submit the senate election collusion case and its 229 suspects to the Supreme Court for judgement.
title_cn: 示威者要求对参议院选举舞弊案进行大规模起诉
summary_cn: 泰国法律改革网络对话组织（iLaw）支持者周日在曼谷游行11公里，要求选举委员会将参议院选举勾结案及其229名嫌疑人提交最高法院审判。这起案件涉及参议院选举过程中的重大舞弊，引发公众和改革派组织的广泛关注。
desc_original: Supporters of Internet Dialogue on Law Reform (iLaw) marched 11-kilometres through Bangkok on Sunday demanding the Election Commission submit the senate election collusion case and its 229 suspects to the Supreme Court for judgement.

desc: ซื้อกองทุนลดหย่อนภาษีทุกปี แต่ไม่รู้ว่าซื้ออะไรไป 3 วิธีปรับมุมมองใหม่ ให้เงินทำงานเพื่ออนาคตของเราอย่างเต็มที่
title_cn: 改变对税收减免基金的认识：3招将其转变为真正投资
summary_cn: 许多投资者每年购买税收减免基金但不清楚具体投向。文章提出3种改变思路的方法，帮助投资者正确认识这类基金的性质，使资金能够为个人未来充分发挥投资作用，实现资产增值。

title: 中国籍“红通”嫌犯潜逃30余年在泰落网
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月13日，泰国国家警察总署副署长萨兰警上将指示诺帕辛警少将组织警力，联合行政人员前往春武里府邦拉蒙县农普鲁镇一处住宅，对芭提雅法院第509/2569号通缉令对象、中国籍“红通”嫌疑人朱志山（化名，Mr. Zhu Zhishan）实施抓捕。 萨兰警上将透露，此前中国通过泰国外交部请求协助追捕并引渡朱志山，其于1990年1月19日在浙江省台州市故意伤害他人，并在案发后逃离中国进入泰国，且已被国际刑警组织列入红色通缉令名单。经过排查，泰国警方认为，这名红通人员很可能就是“苏查·苏拉猜”，其涉嫌非法取得泰国国籍，并曾持有泰国护照。因此，国家警察总署请内政部核查朱志山或苏查·苏拉猜是否曾拥有泰国国籍，以及是否已被取消。 内政部通过反注册安全威胁工作组（DOPA N.I.C.E.）回溯数据后发现，苏查·苏拉猜曾通过达府蓬帕县非法获得泰国国籍，并于2001年11月1日首次办理泰国身份证。后来，相关部门取消了他的泰国国籍及相关户籍记录，并提起诉讼，但他在没有合法泰国国籍的情况下，仍在春武里府邦拉蒙县申请办理身份证，因此被芭提雅签发通缉令。 据嫌疑人朱志山供述，他曾在达府蓬帕县花了约5万泰铢办理泰国身份证，调查人员将针对该说法进行排查，以确定这笔钱付给了谁，是否有人或其他官员涉案，以及是否还有类似情况发生过。 在取得泰国身份后，朱志山长期在泰国谋生，先做导游和旅游业，后转到芭提雅定居，与中国籍女子组建了家庭，并育有一对双胞胎。经进一步调查，警方发现朱志山还与多家公司存在关联，如在邦拉蒙县持有17块不动产，总价值超过1亿泰铢，另有多辆汽车和摩托车，工作人员将继续追查这些资产的来源和合法状态。目前，嫌疑人朱志山已移交至邦拉蒙警察局依法处理，关于中方的引渡申请，国家警察总署将按程序推进。 （编译：KA；来源：dailynews） The post 中国籍“红通”嫌犯潜逃30余年在泰落网 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 中国籍红通通缉犯在泰国被捕 潜逃30余年身份曝光
summary_cn: 中国公民朱志山因1990年在浙江故意伤害他人后逃离中国，被列入国际刑警组织红色通缉名单。他通过非法手段获得泰国身份证并在芭提雅定居，拥有价值超1亿泰铢的不动产。泰国警方根据中方引渡申请在春武里府将其抓捕，调查其资产来源。

title: 佛教办报案，追究泰国歌手“蹭热度”表演
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月13日中午12点，泰国南邦府佛教办公室负责人卡能吉带着证据材料，来到南邦警察局报案，以追究一名歌手及其表演场所的责任。事情起因是南邦府一知名娱乐场所的社交媒体账号发布了一段舞台表演视频，一名男歌手身披橙色布料，看起来很像僧人的打扮，还挂着类似“护身符”的道具做出不雅动作，引发网友热议，其中不少人指责该行为并不恰当。 卡能吉表示，他得知此事后心里很不舒服，这种表演非常不合适，已让办公室法务部门初步研判，其可能触犯的法律。目前来看，可能涉及《刑法》第206条“侮辱宗教”，以及第208条“仿冒僧人装扮”。另外，行政部门也在核查，上述行为是否违反了《娱乐场所管理》和其他规定，计划进一步比对计算机犯罪的相关法律。 卡能吉补充说，现在这些新闻已经让很多虔诚的佛教徒感到失望，他恳请大家不要再给宗教添乱，而是一起护持宗教。同时，也不要执着于某个人，真正的佛教徒应该坚守的是佛法。对于南邦府这一带有贬低意味的表演，其实非常不恰当，所有人都不应该这样做。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 佛教办报案，追究泰国歌手“蹭热度”表演 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 南邦佛教办公室报案 追究歌手不尊重佛教表演
summary_cn: 南邦府一娱乐场所发布的表演视频引发争议，视频中男歌手穿着酷似僧袍衣服并做出不雅动作。南邦佛教办公室认为这严重不尊重佛教，向警方报案。初步判断涉及刑法「侮辱宗教」和「仿冒僧人装扮」条款，相关部门正调查娱乐场所是否违反管理规定。

title: Government warns motorists over fake traffic fine SMS
desc: Government warns motorists over fake traffic fine SMS Legacy The Thai government has warned motorists about fake SMS messages claiming they have unpaid traffic fines , with scammers using links to imitate police websites to steal information . Deputy government spokesperson Ploytalay Laksameesaengchan said today, September 13, that the Royal Thai Police had identified fraudulent messages designed to look like official reminders about unpaid e-Tickets. The messages are typically sent from unfamiliar phone numbers and may say: “RTP: You have an outstanding e-Ticket payment. Please pay at…” followed by a shortened link. Anyone who clicks the link may be taken to a fake website designed to resemble the official traffic ticket system. Photo via Thaigov The site can display convincing details such as a ticket number, vehicle registration, alleged offence and fine amount before asking users to enter personal information, credit or debit card details, and make a payment. Ploytalay stressed that the Royal Thai Police does not have a policy of demanding traffic fine payments through SMS messages containing links or QR codes. People who receive such messages were urged not to click any links,
title_cn: 泰国政府警告：谨防虚假交通罚单短信诈骗
summary_cn: 泰国警方发现诈骗分子通过伪造政府短信（声称有未缴纳电子罚单）进行诈骗。这些短信包含虚假链接指向冒充官方交通罚款系统的假网站，试图骗取用户个人信息和银行卡详情。泰国皇家警察强调官方不会通过短信链接或二维码索要罚款。

title: 青年群体占HIV新发病例1/3，泰国2030能够“终结艾滋”
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月13日，泰国疾病防控厅2026年第三季度的数据显示，泰国累计HIV感染者已超过565,018例，新增感染者达15,578例，主要集中在25-49岁这一年龄段，均需接受抗病毒药物治疗。在预防性用药方面，暴露前预防药物（PrEP）正在从“每日口服片剂”向“长效注射型PrEP”转型，大幅减轻了服药负担，也为使用者提供了更多选择。 此前，疾控厅宣布将引入长效针剂Lenacapavir进行PrEP预防，并拟于年底前在9家医疗服务机构开展试点，覆盖2,400例目标人群，标志着泰国的HIV防控有了重大改善。然而，当前HIV防控的核心问题已不再是缺药或无法获得治疗，而是不知道感染状态、缺乏风险意识以及社会歧视问题，尤其是青年群体中新增的感染者。 泰国艾滋病医疗基金会（AHF）负责人克里斯沙亚指出，过去，泰国年新增的感染者曾高达10万例以上，如今已降至年万余例，这表明泰国的预防与治疗体系取得了明显进步，但LGBTQ+群体的感染率仍高于普通大众。另外，15-24岁的青年群体竟占到了每年新增感染者的三分之一，所以减少新增感染的关键在于，将“对信息的认知”转化为“行为上的改变”。 尽管大多数人都清楚无保护性行为存在风险，但许多人未能将这些常识转化为长期的防护行动。AHF在实际工作中发现，超过96%的新增感染者与无保护性行为有关。同时，这一问题还与其他性传播疾病交织在一起，导致近年来部分性传播疾病的发病率呈上升趋势。PrEP虽然能有效降低HIV的感染风险，但并不能预防其他性传播疾病，如果防艾宣传仅聚焦于HIV而忽略了性传播疾病，可能会让公众产生片面的理解。 在终结艾滋的国家战略层面，泰国定下了在2030年前消除艾滋病危害的目标，包括三大核心指标：1. 每年新增HIV感染者不超过1,000例；2. 每年因HIV死亡的人数不超过4,000；3. 与HIV及性别相关的歧视与偏见下降至10%以内。 现在距离目标期限仅剩4年，但制约泰国按期遏制疫情蔓延的关键因素依然是“社会歧视”。部分感染者宁愿跨区域远赴异地取药，就是担心当地熟人知道自己的病情，这反映出医疗服务的可及性瓶颈并不单单在于缺医少药，更在于社会经济层面的顾虑。另外，部分低收入群体，如日均收入仅200-300泰铢的农户，因无力承担前往医院的交通费，导致随访复诊演变成了沉重的经济负担。 AHF已与全国52家公立医院展开合作，提供交通补贴、安排入户走访并协助解决感染者的实际困难，以填补公立医疗体系难以顾及的空白。不过最严峻的挑战在于“公众不知道自己的感染状态”，如果不做筛查，就无法知道是否感染，也就无法进入诊疗体系并控制病毒。 从医疗保障体系来看，泰国已具备相对完善的条件，目前的抗病毒药物方案已达到国际标准，全民健康覆盖及社保参保人员均可依法享有免费用药权益。但在实际操作中，部分群体仍游离于体系之外，所以当务之急是面
title_cn: 青年占HIV新增病例三分之一，泰国冲刺2030终结艾滋目标
summary_cn: 泰国今年新增HIV感染15,578例，其中青年（15-24岁）占三分之一。当前防控重点已从缺药转向提高检测率和消除社会歧视。政府推出长效针剂Lenacapavir进行暴露前预防，计划年底前在9家机构开展试点。泰国制定了2030年消除艾滋病危害的目标，包括年新增感染控制在1,000例以内。艾滋病医疗基金会（AHF）已与全国52家公立医院展开合作，提供交通补贴和入户服务以消除患者就医障碍。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月13日，泰国疾病防控厅2026年第三季度的数据显示，泰国累计HIV感染者已超过565,018例，新增感染者达15,578例，主要集中在25-49岁这一年龄段，均需接受抗病毒药物治疗。在预防性用药方面，暴露前预防药物（PrEP）正在从“每日口服片剂”向“长效注射型PrEP”转型，大幅减轻了服药负担，也为使用者提供了更多选择。 此前，疾控厅宣布将引入长效针剂Lenacapavir进行PrEP预防，并拟于年底前在9家医疗服务机构开展试点，覆盖2,400例目标人群，标志着泰国的HIV防控有了重大改善。然而，当前HIV防控的核心问题已不再是缺药或无法获得治疗，而是不知道感染状态、缺乏风险意识以及社会歧视问题，尤其是青年群体中新增的感染者。 泰国艾滋病医疗基金会（AHF）负责人克里斯沙亚指出，过去，泰国年新增的感染者曾高达10万例以上，如今已降至年万余例，这表明泰国的预防与治疗体系取得了明显进步，但LGBTQ+群体的感染率仍高于普通大众。另外，15-24岁的青年群体竟占到了每年新增感染者的三分之一，所以减少新增感染的关键在于，将“对信息的认知”转化为“行为上的改变”。 尽管大多数人都清楚无保护性行为存在风险，但许多人未能将这些常识转化为长期的防护行动。AHF在实际工作中发现，超过96%的新增感染者与无保护性行为有关。同时，这一问题还与其他性传播疾病交织在一起，导致近年来部分性传播疾病的发病率呈上升趋势。PrEP虽然能有效降低HIV的感染风险，但并不能预防其他性传播疾病，如果防艾宣传仅聚焦于HIV而忽略了性传播疾病，可能会让公众产生片面的理解。 在终结艾滋的国家战略层面，泰国定下了在2030年前消除艾滋病危害的目标，包括三大核心指标：1. 每年新增HIV感染者不超过1,000例；2. 每年因HIV死亡的人数不超过4,000；3. 与HIV及性别相关的歧视与偏见下降至10%以内。 现在距离目标期限仅剩4年，但制约泰国按期遏制疫情蔓延的关键因素依然是“社会歧视”。部分感染者宁愿跨区域远赴异地取药，就是担心当地熟人知道自己的病情，这反映出医疗服务的可及性瓶颈并不单单在于缺医少药，更在于社会经济层面的顾虑。另外，部分低收入群体，如日均收入仅200-300泰铢的农户，因无力承担前往医院的交通费，导致随访复诊演变成了沉重的经济负担。 AHF已与全国52家公立医院展开合作，提供交通补贴、安排入户走访并协助解决感染者的实际困难，以填补公立医疗体系难以顾及的空白。不过最严峻的挑战在于“公众不知道自己的感染状态”，如果不做筛查，就无法知道是否感染，也就无法进入诊疗体系并控制病毒。 从医疗保障体系来看，泰国已具备相对完善的条件，目前的抗病毒药物方案已达到国际标准，全民健康覆盖及社保参保人员均可依法享有免费用药权益。但在实际操作中，部分群体仍游离于体系之外，所以当务之急是面

title: Chinese man holds Thai woman in Pattaya condo for 3 hours
desc: Chinese man holds Thai woman in Pattaya condo for 3 hours Legacy A Thai woman said she was dragged into a condominium room in Pattaya , held for more than three hours , beaten and subjected to an attempted sexual assault by a Chinese man yesterday, September 12. The 28 year old woman reported the incident to Pattaya City Police Station after eventually being released from the condominium in the Thappraya Road area. She said the incident began after her mobile phone went missing and she suspected a younger female acquaintance had taken it. She later received information that she could retrieve the phone at the condominium and went there with her older sister, a transgender woman . Photo via Pattaya Police According to the woman, a Chinese man inside the room suddenly opened the door and pulled both of them inside. Her sister managed to break free and escape, but the woman said she was left alone in the room and prevented from leaving for more than three hours. She told police the man appeared intoxicated and tried to force her to undress for a sexual assault. When she resisted, he allegedly beat her , leaving her injured. title_cn: 中国男子在芭提雅公寓非法拘禁泰国女性逾3小时

title: Bangkok digs deeper for Rama III oil leak
desc: Bangkok digs deeper for Rama III oil leak Legacy Crews in Bangkok are digging through heavy rain to trace a petroleum leak seeping into the drainage system beneath the Rama III Bridge U-turn, with round-the-clock excavation now under way along Chuea Phloeng Road in Khlong Toei district. Workers are cutting through sections of concrete and following the route of a 14-inch pipeline in an effort to pinpoint the source of the contamination, while residents disturbed by the overnight operation are being offered temporary accommodation elsewhere. Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on September 11 that crews had reached a depth of 2 metres despite the downpour, but had not yet located the leak. The pipeline, now 32 years old, runs at a pressure of 40 bar and supplies petroleum products to depots, airports and Ayutthaya province. Inspection work is continuing along the line towards the nearby railway. Firefighting foam is being used to suppress flammable vapours, and the Lower Explosive Limit is being checked every hour as a safety precaution. Access to the site is restricted, smoking and any spark-producing activity are banned, and the incident command centre has been moved further
title_cn: 曼谷拉玛三世桥石油泄漏，日夜挖掘搜源头
summary_cn: 曼谷拉玛三世桥U型转盘区域发生输油管道泄漏，污染物已进入地下排水系统。工作人员在大雨中沿科佛伦路进行24小时挖掘作业，深度已达2米以上，试图找到这条长32年的输油管道泄漏点。该管道向机场、仓库和大城府等地供应燃油。施工现场已限制进出并采取防火泡沫措施，受影响居民获得临时住宿安排。

title: 泰国将举办亚洲游戏展，向区域产业中心迈进
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月13日，泰国总理府办公室副发言人拉莉达透露，作为最具海外扩张潜力的创意经济板块之一，政府正全力为泰国游戏产业创造商机，包括对接全球合作伙伴、投资者和商业盟友等。即将于10月29日至11月1日在泰国举办的“2026年亚洲国际游戏展览会×泰国游戏展”（gamescom asia × Thailand Game Show 2026）是政府推动本土游戏走向世界市场的成果延伸，将进一步使泰国跃升为东南亚游戏产业的核心枢纽之一。 今年8月26日至30日，商业部国际贸易促进厅（DITP）带领15家泰国游戏企业赴德国科隆参加国际游戏展。这是泰国连续第二年参展，旨在向海外市场推介泰国游戏作品，展示泰国开发商的实力，并为拓展欧洲及全球市场争取合作机会。最终，泰国企业达成的商业洽谈总意向金额达270,369,990泰铢（折合约819万美元），其中即时成交金额40,590泰铢，1年内交易额270,329,400泰铢。参展期间，泰国企业共对接目标客户994家，其中新客户673家，占比67.71%，充分展现出泰国游戏企业的潜质与海外拓展前景。 拉莉达表示，商务洽谈的成果反映了泰国游戏企业具备开发符合国际市场需求的能力，因此，政府将继续把国际赛场的成果转化为本土优势，办好“2026年亚洲国际游戏展览会×泰国游戏展”，使其成为连接国内外游戏产业开发商、投资者及相关从业人员的重要平台，增加区域内商务交流、投资合作和市场拓展的机会。后续，政府仍将持续扩大国际平台带来的贸易与合作网资源，提升泰国游戏产业的竞争力，向东南亚游戏产业中心迈进。 （编译：KA；来源：thairath） The post 泰国将举办亚洲游戏展，向区域产业中心迈进 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国亚洲游戏展十月启幕，跻身东南亚游戏产业枢纽
summary_cn: 泰国政府正推动本土游戏产业国际化。今年8月，泰国商业部派15家游戏企业赴德国科隆参加游戏展，达成商务洽谈意向金额2.7亿泰铢，新客户占比67.71%。10月29日至11月1日，泰国将举办「2026年亚洲国际游戏展览会×泰国游戏展」，作为连接国内外游戏开发商、投资者的重要平台，进一步巩固泰国在东南亚游戏产业的中心地位。

title: 泰国警方深挖知名住持案，或涉更多同伙
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月12日，泰国犯罪缉侦局局长帕塔纳萨警少将透露了大城府知名住持阿提措法师与女香客一案的最新进展，他说，警方正在收集证据以进一步深入调查，工作内容主要分为两个部分： 1. 调查阿提措法师违反僧规的行为，以及他侵吞寺庙资金至个人账户，并以寺庙名义对外开具受捐收据； 2. 排查资金链及其他参与作案的共犯。 就目前已知的证据分析，该案的资金链涉及日常捐款收据、请购佛牌收据和参与寺庙修缮的捐款收据等，累计金额高达2.15亿泰铢，因此警方预计，本案可能还存在1至2名“第三人”。不过，由于相关线索还在收集中，其他参与作案的共犯是香客还是僧侣还需进一步确认。 与此同时，帕塔纳萨警少将还说明了阿提措法师基金会的情况。他表示，该基金会于2026年初开始组建，但理事会的具体成员仍待重新核实。虽然尚不清楚阿提措法师设立基金会的真实意图，但结合其作案手法，警方推测他可能是为了利用该平台洗钱，模式与帕巴喃普寺（Wat Phra Baht Nam Phu）案相似。 关于寺庙目前的财务状况，警方正向反洗钱办公室（AMLO）调取详细数据，以核查资金的流入流出情况、资金来源和最终去向。 至于寺庙制作佛牌及圣物一事，帕塔纳萨警少将证实，该寺多年来持续制作各类佛牌、符管及圣物，但由于部分交易采用现金支付，难以立刻认定入账资金属于请购佛牌还是其他来源，这一项收益的核查难度较大。而制作佛牌的资金是流向了基金会还是寺庙，暂时也无法确定。 帕塔纳萨警少将强调，警方目前仅看到了资金数字，尚未查明其来源与去向，需要时间对整条资金链进行全面的分析。另外，逮捕犯罪嫌疑人并不意味着能立刻掌握所有细节，警方仍须依据确凿证据和法医物证，不能仅凭单方面的指认或供词来定案。 （编译：KA；来源：pptvhd36） The post 泰国警方深挖知名住持案，或涉更多同伙 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 大城府知名住持贪污案再深挖，资金链达2.15亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国大城府知名住持阿提措法师涉嫌侵吞寺庙资金并洗钱。警方已查明涉案资金链高达2.15亿泰铢，来源包括日常捐款、佛牌请购和修缮捐款。目前警方推测可能还有1至2名共犯参与，需进一步确认。该住持设立的基金会成立于2026年初，警方怀疑系为洗钱目的，犯罪模式类似于Wat Phra Baht Nam Phu案。警方已向反洗钱办公室调取数据，继续追查资金来源和去向。

title: 泰国政府AI项目受热捧，超120万人完成单门课程
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月12日，泰国国家数字经济与社会委员会办公室（BDE）秘书长维唐透露，提升泰国人数字与人工智能技能的TH-AI Passport项目进展顺利，截至9月11日，成功注册人数已达152万，累计使用指令超过8,720,807次。同时，完成任意一门课程的累计人次共1,297,924，按条件完成全部课程并获得证书的达139,519。 BDE从8月18日开始向所有政府部门发文，以在8月31日正式开放使用前，广泛宣传项目信息。政府部门、其他国家机构、私营企业和媒体等都可以推广TH-AI Passport项目，帮助更多民众了解并参与，为公众创造实际利益。 学生、大学生和AI初学者是项目的重点关注对象，政府希望通过真实试用和学习，让民众真正“接触、理解、使用”。为此，BDE请高等教育、科学与研究创新部、教育部、公共卫生部和其他政府部门协助，向学生、师生和教育工作者宣传TH-AI Passport项目，让目标人群可以免费使用前沿AI应用一年，辅助学习、研究和工作。 关于新合同下的费用计算，采用“按实际活跃用户付费”模式。“实际用户”的定义为：达到“创造新内容”级别、每月至少使用一次的人，收费标准为每人每月24.6951泰铢。维唐强调，推广TH-AI Passport项目的目的是通过各类课程和多种模型，让广大民众掌握AI技术使用技能，缩小技术获取差距，培养能适应技术变化的国家人才。 （编译：KA；来源：thestandard） The post 泰国政府AI项目受热捧，超120万人完成单门课程 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: 泰国力争2028加入OECD
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月12日，泰国总理府办公室副发言人拉莉达透露，政府正在加快加入经济合作与发展组织（OECD）的进程，目标已锁定为2028年。同时，政府不只是关注成员身份，而是期望借OECD标准推动国家改革，涵盖经济、投资、税收、行政体系、劳动力、数字化及教育，全面提升泰国的竞争力。 目前，泰国的申请已进入技术审查阶段。2025年12月8日，泰国提交了初步备忘录，此后OECD的25个技术委员会将逐一审查泰国在各领域的法律、政策和实践，并提出需要改进的地方。政府已指定34个部门共同推进，由总理兼内政部部长阿努廷担任主席的国家机制负责统筹和督促，确保法律和政策调整步调一致。 拉莉达表示，政府考虑的不仅是泰国加入OECD的时间，还包括在这个过程中国家能力的提升，例如提高生产力、营造公平竞争、减少企业和商业的程序负担、让行政体系更灵活透明，以及培养具备新经济所需技能的人才等。 在教育方面，OECD于2026年9月8日公布的PISA 2025结果释放了积极信号。泰国学生的三项成绩都比2022年有所进步：科学从409分升至432分，数学从394分升至407分，阅读从379分升至392分。虽然仍低于OECD的平均水平，但显示出泰国教育正在向好的方向发展。 另外，这次PISA 2025成绩上升，是在2024-2025学年持续落实相关措施后取得的。正式考试于2025年8月举行，由当时教育部的管理团队整合有关部门共同推进，重点提升阅读、数学和科学技能，并为教师、学生、学习材料和电脑考试系统做好准备。从当前的数据看，泰国学生达到基础水平及以上的比例为：科学59%，数学和阅读均为41%；而OECD平均值分别是74%、65%和69%。提升教育质量直接关系到劳动生产率、技术接受能力和国家长期竞争力，政府将继续努力，加快弥补差距。 拉莉达补充说，加入OECD不只是获得成员身份，而是要在过程中真正让国家变得更好，企业要更有竞争力，行政体系要更灵活透明，泰国人要具备更高技能。PISA成绩的上升，说明持续打基础和推进工作是能带来改变的，政府将巩固已经做好的部分，同时尽快解决不足，让泰国在全球经济中更有竞争力。2028年是泰国设定的目标，接下来还要通过OECD各委员会的评估，并完成相关法律、政策和实践的改进，最后由OECD理事会决定是否接纳泰国为正式成员。 （编译：KA；来源：matichon） The post 泰国力争2028加入OECD appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา ประกาศฉบับ 13 ไทยฝนตกหนักบางแห่ง เตือนระวังน้ำท่วมฉับพลัน-น้ำป่าหลาก
desc: กรมอุตุนิยมวิทยา ประกาศฉบับ 13 ไทยฝนตกหนักบางพื้นที่ เตือนระวังน้ำท่วมฉับพลัน-น้ำป่าหลาก เช็กรายชื่อจังหวัดเตรียมรับมือผลกระทบ
title_cn: 泰国气象部门发布第13号公告，多地降雨强劲，需警惕洪灾风险
summary_cn: 泰国气象局（Thailand Meteorological Department）发布第13号天气预报公告，警告全国多个地区将出现强降雨天气。民众需做好防范准备，特别要警惕可能发生的山洪和快速泛滥。受影响地区应及时了解最新气象信息，提前采取防灾措施。

title: ราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 13 กันยายน 2569 อัปเดตล่าสุด "เบนซิน-ดีเซล" ลิตรละกี่บาท
desc: อัปเดตราคาน้ำมันวันนี้ 13 กันยายน 2569 เช็กราคาน้ำมันทุกชนิด กลุ่มเบนซิน, แก๊สโซฮอล์, ดีเซล จากปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท., บางจาก, พีที, คาลเท็กซ์, ซัสโก้ และเชลล์ ล่าสุดราคาลิตรละกี่บาทแล้ว
title_cn: 「2026年9月13日汽油柴油价格最新公布」
summary_cn: 根据9月13日最新数据，泰国各主要油品价格实时更新。涵盖汽油、汽油混合燃料、柴油等多种油品类型，来源于泰国石油（PTT）、中华石油（Bangchak）、皮通石油、卡尔泰克斯（Caltex）、萨斯科、壳牌（Shell）等主要加油站网络的最新价格数据。消费者可随时查询各油品每升的最新市场行情。

title: Govt denies role in US corn deal
desc: The government on Saturday denied reports Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun had signed an agreement to import one million tonnes of feed corn from the United States, saying the deal was between private companies.
title_cn: 「政府否认参与美国饲料玉米进口协议」
summary_cn: 泰国政府周六否认商业部长素帕杰·苏通蒙（Suphajee Suthumpun）签署进口100万吨美国饲料玉米协议的报道，澄清该交易系私营企业之间的商业合作，政府不涉及此事。此举打消了外界关于政府直接参与大规模农产品进口的猜测。
desc_original: The government on Saturday denied reports Commerce Minister Suphajee Suthumpun had signed an agreement to import one million tonnes of feed corn from the United States, saying the deal was between private companies.

title: CSD probes ex-monk's foundation over suspected laundering
desc: The Crime Suppression Division (CSD) is investigating a foundation recently established by former monk Atichot Tanprasert amid concerns it may have been used to launder money.
title_cn: 「刑警部门调查前僧人基金会涉嫌洗钱」
summary_cn: 泰国刑事镇压处（Crime Suppression Division）正调查前僧人阿蒂乔特·坦普拉塞特（Atichot Tanprasert）最近成立的基金会，怀疑其涉嫌洗钱活动。此项调查是打击非法资金流动的重要举措，反映了泰国对宗教慈善组织资金来源的严格监督。
desc_original: The Crime Suppression Division (CSD) is investigating a foundation recently established by former monk Atichot Tanprasert amid concerns it may have been used to launder money.

title: Police rescue student after 1.78m baht call centre scam
desc: Police have rescued a 22-year-old student who was manipulated by a call-centre gang into fabricating a story about winning a scholarship to study in the United States before transferring more than 1.78 million baht to the scammers.
title_cn: 「警方击破诈骗团伙 22岁学生被骗178万泰铢」
summary_cn: 泰国警方成功营救一名22岁学生，该生被呼叫中心诈骗团伙欺骗，编造赴美留学获得奖学金的谎言，诱骗受害人转账超过178万泰铢。警方此举揭露了针对青年学生精心策划的跨国诈骗手法，提醒在泰学生谨防此类欺诈。
desc_original: Police have rescued a 22-year-old student who was manipulated by a call-centre gang into fabricating a story about winning a scholarship to study in the United States before transferring more than 1.78 million baht to the scammers.

title: Israeli land network faces law
desc: Justice Minister Pol Lt Gen Rutthaphon Naowarat says authorities are preparing legal action against a suspected network of Israeli nationals holding land in Pattaya, Chon Buri, as part of investigations into transnational crime.
title_cn: 「当局对芭提雅以色列地产网络采取法律行动」
summary_cn: 泰国司法部长盼·瑙瓦拉特（Pol Lt Gen Rutthaphon Naowarat）表示，当局正准备对在芭提雅（Pattaya）和春武里府（Chon Buri）涉嫌非法持有土地的以色列国民网络采取法律行动，作为跨国犯罪调查的一部分。该案件反映泰国对外国人不规范房产活动的严格监管。
desc_original: Justice Minister Pol Lt Gen Rutthaphon Naowarat says authorities are preparing legal action against a suspected network of Israeli nationals holding land in Pattaya, Chon Buri, as part of investigations into transnational crime.

title: Chuan warns agencies on political interference
desc: Chuan Leekpai, a Democrat Party list MP, on Saturday urged independent organisations to uphold integrity, impartiality and good governance in the face of political interference.
title_cn: 差万警告独立机构勿受政治干预
summary_cn: 民主党议员差万·李克派周六敦促独立机构在面对政治干预时，坚守廉洁、公正和善政原则，维护机构独立性和公信力。
desc_original: Chuan Leekpai, a Democrat Party list MP, on Saturday urged independent organisations to uphold integrity, impartiality and good governance in the face of political interference.

title: Mass protests await key rulings
desc: Former leader of the People's Alliance for Democracy, Sondhi Limthongkul, is trying to pressure the government regarding the issue of "transnational grey capital". However, his campaign has not yet gained enough momentum to develop into a mass protest movement.
title_cn: 关键裁决前夕 大规模抗议蓄势待发
summary_cn: 民众联盟前领导人颂帝·林通昆正就「跨境灰色资本」问题向政府施压，试图掀起抗议浪潮，但目前运动尚未积累足够声势演变成大规模群众运动。
desc_original: Former leader of the People's Alliance for Democracy, Sondhi Limthongkul, is trying to pressure the government regarding the issue of "transnational grey capital". However, his campaign has not yet gained enough momentum to develop into a mass protest movement.

title: TDRI urges EC to act on Senate case
desc: Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) president Somkiat Tangkitvanich has called on the Election Commission (EC) to submit the Senate election collusion case to the Supreme Court promptly, saying it would restore public confidence.
title_cn: 泰国发展研究所敦促选举委员会加快参议院案件处理
summary_cn: 泰国发展研究所主席颂基亚·堂基万威奇敦促选举委员会迅速将参议院选举共谋案提交最高法院裁决，称此举有助恢复公众对制度的信心。
desc_original: Thailand Development Research Institute (TDRI) president Somkiat Tangkitvanich has called on the Election Commission (EC) to submit the Senate election collusion case to the Supreme Court promptly, saying it would restore public confidence.

title: More funds needed to fight tilapia infestation
desc: The Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives may seek about 350 million baht in additional funds to control the spread of blackchin tilapia, as the presence of the invasive fish has now been reported in 21 provinces, a deputy government spokeswoman says.
title_cn: 防控黑鳃罗非鱼入侵需追加3.5亿泰铢资金
summary_cn: 农业和合作部拟申请约3.5亿泰铢追加资金应对黑鳃罗非鱼蔓延。该入侵鱼种目前已在泰国21个府现身，威胁本地生态系统。
desc_original: The Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives may seek about 350 million baht in additional funds to control the spread of blackchin tilapia, as the presence of the invasive fish has now been reported in 21 provinces, a deputy government spokeswoman says.

title: Intercity bus fares to rise from Tuesday
desc: Intercity bus fares will rise by 3 satang per kilometre from Tuesday after diesel prices climbed to 39.84 baht a litre, the Department of Land Transport (DLT) said on Saturday.
title_cn: 城际巴士车费周二起上调
summary_cn: 受柴油价格上涨至每升39.84泰铢影响，陆运部宣布从本周二起调高城际巴士票价，增幅为每公里3撒当，将直接影响日常乘客出行成本。
desc_original: Intercity bus fares will rise by 3 satang per kilometre from Tuesday after diesel prices climbed to 39.84 baht a litre, the Department of Land Transport (DLT) said on Saturday.

title: Cambodia used Preah Vihear as base: Prapas
desc: Thailand has evidence Cambodia used Preah Vihear Temple as a military base, Air Chief Marshal Prapas Sornchaidee, director of the Thailand-Cambodia Joint Information Centre (JIC), said on Saturday.
title_cn: 柬埔寨在玛哈其越寺建立军事基地：帕帕斯表示泰国掌握证据
summary_cn: 泰国空军总司令帕帕斯·松才迪（Prapas Sornchaidee）表示，泰国已掌握柬埔寨在玛哈其越寺（Preah Vihear Temple）建立军事基地的证据。帕帕斯现任泰柬联合信息中心（JIC）主任。玛哈其越寺位于泰柬边界，为两国长期争议的世界遗产，此举反映两国在边境地区的紧张局势。
desc_original: Thailand has evidence Cambodia used Preah Vihear Temple as a military base, Air Chief Marshal Prapas Sornchaidee, director of the Thailand-Cambodia Joint Information Centre (JIC), said on Saturday.

title: Bangkok police arrest two in hornbill and gibbon trafficking bust
desc: Bangkok police arrest two in hornbill and gibbon trafficking bust Legacy Two men have been arrested in Bangkok after undercover police posed as buyers to intercept a protected rhinoceros hornbill and a gibbon being sold as part of an alleged international wildlife trafficking operation. The suspects, a 35 year old Cambodian national and a 39 year old Thai man, were caught after agreeing to meet officers at a petrol station on Vibhavadi Rangsit Road in Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai district, to complete the sale. The Central Investigation Bureau, the Natural Resources and Environmental Crime Suppression Division’s “Wild Hawk” team, the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation, and the US Fish and Wildlife Service jointly announced the arrests. Investigators had been probing a wider trafficking network accused of smuggling protected animals onto flights bound for Taiwan and India. During the investigation, officers identified the Cambodian suspect as an alleged key supplier sourcing animals for buyers abroad through online channels. title_cn: 传染病防控部门加强SFTS监测，蜱虫为传播媒介，泰国面临疫情风险
summary_cn: 泰国卫生部传染病防控部门发布发热伴血小板减少综合征（SFTS）防控指南。SFTS由蜱虫传播，是由新型布尼亚病毒引起的传染病，具有较高致死率。目前泰国已发现患者散布在6个省份，当局评估存在新增病例风险，已准备加强疾病检测与防控措施应对潜在疫情蔓延。

title_cn: 普吉岛成年海草龟搁浅获救，海洋部门紧急救护
summary_cn: 泰国海洋资源与海岸保护部门在普吉岛（Phuket）海滩救助一只成年海草龟。该龟因搁浅无法自救，经检查发现嘴部和颈部皮肤出现感染症状，部门已将其送往救护中心进行医疗救治与康复训练，待恢复后放归大海。此举体现泰国对海洋生态与濒危物种的保护承诺。

title: Phuket Jewish New Year event cancelled on security grounds
desc: A Jewish New Year celebration in Phuket was cancelled at the last minute on Friday evening because of concerns raised by Israeli security officials, organisers said.

title: Bangchak says no leaks found in Bangkok fuel pipeline
desc: Bangchak Group said no leaks were found in a fuel pipeline along Chuea Phloeng Road in Klong Toey district of Bangkok following an inspection after thousands of litres of oil-contaminated wastewater were reported in the area.
title_cn: 邦查克称曼谷油管检查未发现泄漏
summary_cn: 泰国邦查克集团（Bangchak Group）宣布，对位于曼谷隆都区（Klong Toey）楚亚普鲁英路（Chuea Phloeng Road）的燃油管道进行检查后，未发现任何泄漏点。此前该区域曾报告出现数千升含油废水，引发环保和安全关切。公司的检查报告旨在消除公众疑虑。

title: Bad Buddhists beget bad Buddhists
desc: The salacious nature of the news surrounding the former monk Atichot Thanprasert all but ensures it will dominate coverage for days and weeks to come. But the issue of an esteemed Buddhist leader betraying all the values he represented in spectacular fashion and what that means for Thailand’s faithful is unlikely to be the core of the discussion — and that is the real problem.
title_cn: 信仰沦陷的恶性循环
summary_cn: 前高僧Atichot Thanprasert的丑闻将长期占据舆论关注，但公众讨论可能流于八卦，而忽视了这位佛教领袖背叛信仰对泰国佛教体系本身的深层影响。媒体和社会需要反思的关键问题——佛教信徒教育与道德传承——容易被边缘化。

title: Illegal weight-loss products worth B50 million seized
desc: Unregistered weight-loss injection pens and related materials worth more than 50 million baht were seized on Friday at a house in Nonthaburi, where the seller had been earning an estimated 8 million baht a month from online sales for the past year.
title_cn: 非法减肥针被查，涉案5000万泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国执法部门在暖武里查获大规模非法减肥产品案，缴获未注册的减肥针剂及配套物品共计价值5000万泰铢。嫌疑人通过线上销售渠道运营一年，月均非法所得约800万泰铢，目前已被拘留调查。案件涉及多个城市的销售网络。

title: Cabinet approves 106 billion baht for southern double-track railway
desc: Cabinet approves 106 billion baht for southern double-track railway Legacy The Cabinet has approved 106,798.32 million baht for three southern double-track railway projects running from Chumphon to the Malaysian border at Padang Besar. Ministers approved the plan at a mobile meeting in Songkhla on September 1, chaired by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul. The Chumphon to Surat Thani line takes 36,892.32 million baht over seven years from fiscal year 2026. The Surat Thani to Hat Yai Junction section takes 61,534.55 million baht over eight years. The Hat Yai Junction to Padang Besar line takes 8,371.45 million baht over six years. The Chumphon line is up from 30,422.53 million baht first proposed in 2025, and the Padang Besar line from 7,772.90 million. The government put the rises down to design changes, including level crossings and flood prevention, and to higher material, diesel, land and compensation costs. The supervision fee also rose from 2.25% to 2.75% of construction cost. The Cabinet held back the Hat Yai to Songkhla section, about 29.22 kilometres estimated at 15,922.42 million baht, until encroachers leave the land. The State Railway of Thailand expects to sign contract

title: Diesel price pushes veteran Phitsanulok songthaew driver off his route
desc: Diesel price pushes veteran Phitsanulok songthaew driver off his route Legacy Songthaew drivers on the Phitsanulok to Bang Rakam route plan to stop service by the end of this year, blaming soaring diesel prices and a steep drop in passengers. Some trips cost drivers up to 200 baht in fuel for just one paying passenger, earning only 80 baht between the fare and a parcel fee, a shortfall that happens almost daily. Pairoh has cut back to one trip a day, but some weeks still bring in just 50 to 100 baht in profit. The route once had as many as nine songthaews. Five remain, and more could go if diesel stays this expensive, Thai PBS reported. Fuel prices across Thailand’s major retailers remained unchanged on Thursday, September 10, with six leading brands posting near-identical rates at the pump. title: 中国男子芭提雅殴打拘禁泰女，拒警方调查被架回警局
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道，9月12日，一名28岁泰国女子报案称，其在芭堤雅塔帕亚路附近一处公寓内遭一名中国籍男子限制人身自由并殴打，期间还被强迫脱衣，疑遭强迫实施性行为。警方随后前往涉事公寓将该男子带回警局调查，但男子在过程中持续挣扎、拒不配合，警方最终架住其双臂将其带回警局。 9月12日凌晨6时，28岁的Beam前往芭堤雅市警察局报案并向警方陈述事发经过。她表示，事发前自己的手机遗失，怀疑一名相识的年轻女子可能拿走了手机。随后，她接到消息称，若想取回手机，需要前往芭堤雅塔帕亚路附近一处公寓。于是，她与跨性别人士的姐姐一同前往。 Beam称，抵达公寓房间后，一名中国籍男子开门并将她和姐姐拉进房间，随后双方发生肢体冲突。其姐姐成功挣脱并逃离房间，但她本人未能离开。 据Beam向警方陈述，该男子随后将她留在房内，限制其离开，持续时间超过3小时。期间，男子要求她脱去衣物并试图对她实施性方面的强迫行为，但遭到拒绝。随后她遭到男子殴打并受伤。 Beam还称，事发期间该男子疑似处于醉酒状态，曾拿出约30个含毒品的烟弹给她查看。之后，她的朋友赶到现场将她救出并陪同前往警局报案。 警方接到报警后，立即派出调查人员及巡逻警员前往涉事公寓，并与公寓管理方协调，由工作人员带领警方前往相关房间。警方随后发现涉事中国籍男子并将其带回芭堤雅市警察局接受进一步调查。 然而，在被带回警局的过程中，该男子情绪激动并持续挣扎、拒绝配合警方工作，导致执法过程一度陷入困难。警方最终将其双臂控制，强行带回警局。 在接受调查期间，该男子无法出示相关身份证件供警方核查。警方表示，目前仍在进一步调查案件，将全面收集相关事实证据及证人证言，依法确保案件涉及各方获得公平对待。在核实相关证据后，警方将根据调查结果依法作出后续处理。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：ch7hd_news） The post 中国男子芭提雅殴打拘禁泰女，拒警方调查被架回警局 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Bank of Thailand and lenders tighten customer checks against illicit money
desc: Bank of Thailand and lenders tighten customer checks against illicit money Legacy The Bank of Thailand is tightening checks on customers under a new framework agreed with 11 financial-sector associations, announced on September 10. Governor Vitai Ratanakorn said the Framework for Safeguarding the Financial Sector from Illicit Activities aims to stop criminals exploiting the financial system. The central bank said participating firms will strengthen know your customer, customer due diligence and enhanced due diligence requirements. High-risk cash transactions face closer scrutiny. Technology-based detection of unusual transactions also forms part of the package. They include the Thai Bankers’ Association, the Association of International Banks and the Government Financial Institutions Association. The Thai E-Payment Trade Association, the Thai Association of Foreign Exchange and Financial Services and six non-bank lenders’ associations make up the rest. Bloomberg reported that together they span banks, non-bank lenders, payment providers and money changers. title: House committee presses crackdown on foreign nominee property in Pattaya
desc: House committee presses crackdown on foreign nominee property in Pattaya Legacy A House committee is pressing for a system-wide crackdown on foreign nominee businesses in Thailand’s tourist cities, including Pattaya . The tourism committee met at Parliament on September 10 with officials from eight agencies, spokesman Yodchai Peungporn said. Yodchai said police had found about 14,000 companies that fit the nominee profile in the fourth phase of their crackdown, which covers Pattaya. He called “grey Thais”, foreigners who hold land using Thai identity cards, a key part of the problem and a grave threat. Because they transact as Thais, he said, the country risks losing land, economic activity and state revenue, Dailynews reported. Nationwide, officials have identified 36,277 foreign-invested companies holding 305,838 land plots. High-risk nominee registrations fell from 894 in August 2025 to 163 in August 2026, government spokesman Ekkapop Pienpises said, Thai Examiner reported. The Anti-Money Laundering Office has seized or frozen 34 more assets, worth about 8.27 billion baht, in the Yim Liak and Ben Smith case. That brings the case to 102 assets worth about 20.39 billion baht
title_cn: 议会推进芭提雅外籍代理人房产整治
summary_cn: 泰国议会旅游委员会推动打击旅游城市外籍代理购房。警方在芭提雅第四阶段打击中识别约14000家符合代理模式的公司。全国已确认36277家外资控股公司持有305838块地块。「灰皮泰人」（持泰国身份证的外籍人士）被指是关键问题，导致国家流失土地、经济活动和税收。高风险代理注册案从2025年8月的894起降至2026年8月的163起。
desc_original: House committee presses crackdown on foreign nominee property in Pattaya Legacy A House committee is pressing for a system-wide crackdown on foreign nominee businesses in Thailand’s tourist cities, including Pattaya . The tourism committee met at Parliament on September 10 with officials from eight agencies, spokesman Yodchai Peungporn said. Yodchai said police had found about 14,000 companies that fit the nominee profile in the fourth phase of their crackdown, which covers Pattaya. He called “grey Thais”, foreigners who hold land using Thai identity cards, a key part of the problem and a grave threat. Because they transact as Thais, he said, the country risks losing land, economic activity and state revenue, Dailynews reported. Nationwide, officials have identified 36,277 foreign-invested companies holding 305,838 land plots. High-risk nominee registrations fell from 894 in August 2025 to 163 in August 2026, government spokesman Ekkapop Pienpises said, Thai Examiner reported. The Anti-Money Laundering Office has seized or frozen 34 more assets, worth about 8.27 billion baht, in the Yim Liak and Ben Smith case. That brings the case to 102 assets worth about 20.39 billion baht

title: 泰国部长强调知名住持事件是个人问题，与信仰无关
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月11日，泰国旅游与体育部部长、泰自豪党大城府核心人物素拉萨在接受采访时表示，大城府普泰沙万寺（Wat Phutthaisawan）历史悠久，有多位阿瑜陀耶王朝国王的御像和神圣的卧佛，建筑很美，尤其是湄南河沿岸的佛塔，此前多位住持都深受大城府民众尊敬，比如銮普銮法师。这次前住持阿提措法师涉嫌行为不端、并被犯罪缉侦局警察以挪用公款罪逮捕一事是个人过错，民众分得清。 寺庙里的神圣之处，游客和大城府人应该还是信任的，借佛教做不好的事情是人的错，佛教本身不会教人这么做。有人担心，前住持事件会变成信仰危机，影响大城府的古迹旅游，素拉萨对此回应说，僧人相关的丑闻不是第一次出现，来普泰沙万寺的信众大多不是来拜那个出问题的人，而是来拜大殿里的卧佛。犯错的人跟佛没关系，普泰沙万寺依然是重要泰国的寺庙，相信人们还是会来礼拜神圣的卧佛，也会来旅游。 （编译：KA；来源：nationtv） The post 泰国部长强调知名住持事件是个人问题，与信仰无关 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Officials raid Pathum Thani clinic run without a doctor
desc: Officials raid Pathum Thani clinic run without a doctor Legacy Health officials and police raided an illegal clinic in Pathum Thani on September 10, acting on a tip-off. The premises sat inside a dormitory in the Klong 3 area of Rangsit. The Department of Health Service Support led the raid with the Pathum Thani health office and the Consumer Protection Police Division. Officials found a 39 year old man who presented himself as the manager of the premises. No doctor was working there. A nursing assistant was treating patients alone. The man faces three charges. Practising medicine without a licence carries up to three years in prison, a fine of up to 30,000 baht, or both. Running a healthcare facility without a licence carries up to five years, a fine of up to 100,000 baht, or both. Selling drugs without a licence carries up to five years, a fine of up to 10,000 baht, or both. The charges fall under the Medical Profession Act of 1982, the Healthcare Facility Act of 1998 and the Drug Act of 1967. Officials handed the man to police investigators for prosecution. Dr. Phuwadet Surakhot, director-general of the Department of Health Service Support, announced the raid and what inspectors
title_cn: 巴吞他尼非法诊所被查 无医生在岗单人接诊

title: 外国人上半年买走6533套泰国公寓，中国最多
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月11日，泰国政府住房银行房地产信息中心（REIC）公布了2026年第二季度和上半年全国范围内的外国人公寓产权过户报告。数据显示，市场在第二季度已有回暖迹象，过户套数和金额均呈现增长，但上半年整体仍低于去年同期，反映出外国买家受国内外经济压力影响，购买力仍偏弱。 2026年第二季度，全国范围内向外国人过户的公寓共3292套，较去年同期增长1.4%；总金额148.03亿泰铢，增长20.2%；总面积14.514万平方米，增长8.1%。不过，从公寓过户的全部数据来看，外国人的占比下降，套数只占10.2%，金额占20.0%，说明第二季度外国人的购房套数虽只小幅增加，金额却明显增长了20.2%，远高于套数增幅。 1至6月，全国范围内向外国人过户的公寓共6533套，比去年同期减少8.8%；总金额282.67亿泰铢，下降1.5%；外国人在整个公寓市场中的占比也在下降，购房套数占11.7%，金额占21.7%。REIC指出，上半年数据放缓表明，国内外经济都在减速，部分外国买家因此推迟了购房和投资决定。 按过户金额排名，中国大陆仍是最大买家，套数和金额都排第一，上半年共买走1813套，总金额68.74亿泰铢，平均每套380万泰铢。然而，中国大陆买家的购房套数下降了23.8%，总金额下降27.7%。 上半年购买泰国公寓金额最高的前10个国家和地区如下： 1. 中国大陆：1813套，68.74亿泰铢 2. 俄罗斯：842套，36.03亿泰铢 3. 缅甸：641套，24.57亿泰铢 4. 美国：254套，16.68亿泰铢 5. 中国台湾：334套，14.65亿泰铢 6. 法国：291套，12.11亿泰铢 7. 英国：255套，11.16亿泰铢 8. 德国：241套，9.54亿泰铢 9. 澳大利亚：185套，8.14亿泰铢 10. 印度：128套，8.10亿泰铢 其中，俄罗斯和澳大利亚增长最突出。俄罗斯套数增加50.4%，金额增长75.9%；澳大利亚套数增加63.7%，金额增长61.0%。按单套平均金额看，美国买家最高，平均660万泰铢一套；印度次之，平均630万泰铢一套。另外，印度买家选择的面积最大，平均每套72.1平方米；中国大陆买家的平均面积为38.2平方米。 总体来看，上半年向外国人过户的公寓，平均每套430万泰铢，平均面积43.9平方米，折合约每平方米98566泰铢。公寓市场中的外国人占比依然处于放缓状态，尤其是作为主力的中国大陆买家购买力有所下降。与此同时，俄罗斯、澳大利亚、德国和印度买家呈增长趋势，下半年仍值得继续关注。 （编译：KA；来源：thansettakij） The post 外国人上半年买走6533套泰国公寓，中国最多 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .

title: Thai HIV doctor wins WHO regional award
desc: A Thai HIV specialist has become the first Thai recipient of the World Health Organization's South-East Asia Regional Award for Public Health Champions.
title_cn: 泰国HIV医学专家获WHO区域公共卫生奖
summary_cn: 一名泰国HIV/艾滋病专家创造历史，成为首位获得世界卫生组织(WHO)南亚太地区公共卫生杰出人物奖的泰国人。这一殊荣表彰了该医学家在防治艾滋病领域的卓越贡献。
desc_original: A Thai HIV specialist has become the first Thai recipient of the World Health Organization's South-East Asia Regional Award for Public Health Champions.

title: "เอไอเอส" สร้างคนเหนือเทคโนโลยี เปิดเวที “AIS ACADEMY For THAIs 2026”
desc: เอไอเอสเปิดเวทีงาน “AIS ACADEMY For THAIs 2026” ปีที่ 8 ย้ำความสำเร็จองค์กรยุค AI คีย์หลักคือการทำให้คนเรียนรู้เทคโนโลยี แทนที่จะซื้อเทคโนโลยีอย่างเดียว
title_cn: AIS 第八届「AIS ACADEMY For THAIs 2026」平台开启 打造科技赋能人才
summary_cn: 泰国电信巨头 AIS 启动第八届「AIS ACADEMY For THAIs 2026」人才培养计划，首次强调「人才赋能」而非单纯购买技术的战略定位，旨在应对 AI 时代背景下泰国本土科技人才的紧缺。该项目被视为 AIS 数字化转型时期的关键人才战略。

title: Craft beer group flags tighter ad rules
desc: The Craft Beer Trade Association is concerned the principles for drafting subordinate legislation regarding alcohol advertising may introduce stricter rules, potentially contradicting the objectives of the new Alcoholic Beverage Control Act, which aims to promote greater openness and flexibility.
title_cn: 泰国精酿啤酒业界警示：新酒精法配套广告规则恐过严
summary_cn: 泰国精酿啤酒贸易协会对新《酒精饮料管制法》的配套立法表示担忧，认为计划中的广告管理原则可能导致过度严格的限制措施，与该法案促进市场开放和灵活性的核心目标相悖。业界呼吁权衡监管与产业发展的平衡。
desc_original: The Craft Beer Trade Association is concerned the principles for drafting subordinate legislation regarding alcohol advertising may introduce stricter rules, potentially contradicting the objectives of the new Alcoholic Beverage Control Act, which aims to promote greater openness and flexibility.

title: SEC moves to bolster local capital market
desc: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is stepping up efforts to strengthen the capital market by expanding the domestic investor base, streamlining initial public offering (IPO) approvals and promoting digital investment products, while tightening enforcement against financial fraud.
title_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会推进本土资本市场建设 IPO 审批加速
summary_cn: 泰国证券交易委员会（SEC）启动系列强化措施，包括扩大散户投资者基数、简化首次公开募股（IPO）流程、推广数字投资产品，同时强化对金融欺诈的执法。该政策旨在吸引更多资本流入国内市场，增强市场竞争力。
desc_original: The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is stepping up efforts to strengthen the capital market by expanding the domestic investor base, streamlining initial public offering (IPO) approvals and promoting digital investment products, while tightening enforcement against financial fraud.

title: Small nuclear reactor plans begin
desc: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat) has outlined a five-phase roadmap to develop the country's first small modular reactor (SMR), with a 300-megawatt unit scheduled to begin commercial operation in 2037 under the new power development plan (PDP).
title_cn: 泰国启动首座小型核反应堆开发 2037 年投入商业运营
summary_cn: 泰国电力生成局（Egat）制定五阶段发展路线图，推进泰国首个小型模块化反应堆（SMR）项目。该 300 兆瓦示范机组纳入新版《国家电力发展计划》，预计 2037 年起开始商业运营，为泰国能源供应结构增添清洁电源选项。
desc_original: The Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (Egat) has outlined a five-phase roadmap to develop the country's first small modular reactor (SMR), with a 300-megawatt unit scheduled to begin commercial operation in 2037 under the new power development plan (PDP).

title: Mortgage holders to get more debt repayment help
desc: Authorities are expected to roll out additional debt restructuring measures for mortgage borrowers as their debt-servicing ability has weakened amid slower economic growth.
title_cn: 泰国推出新增房贷债务重组计划 缓解借款人还款压力
summary_cn: 鉴于经济增速放缓冲击借款人债务服务能力，泰国政府计划推出新增债务重组措施，专项帮助房贷借款人改善还款能力。该政策反映政府对房地产市场风险和家庭债务水平的关切，预计将于近期正式推行。
desc_original: Authorities are expected to roll out additional debt restructuring measures for mortgage borrowers as their debt-servicing ability has weakened amid slower economic growth.

title: 'Thai Travel Plus' scheme heads towards cabinet vote
desc: The "Thai Travel Plus" stimulus scheme will be submitted to the cabinet for approval on Sept 22, Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Pancharoenworakul said, adding that it is expected to generate 20 billion baht in economic activity.
title_cn: 「泰国旅游+」刺激方案即将提交内阁表决
summary_cn: 泰国旅游和体育部部长Surasak Pancharoenworakul宣布，「泰国旅游+」刺激方案将于9月22日提交内阁批准，预计将产生200亿泰铢的经济活动。该方案旨在通过优惠政策刺激国内旅游消费，拉动经济增长。
desc_original: The "Thai Travel Plus" stimulus scheme will be submitted to the cabinet for approval on Sept 22, Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Pancharoenworakul said, adding that it is expected to generate 20 billion baht in economic activity.

title: PM orders airport link reprieve
desc: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) to urgently resolve problems with the Airport Rail Link and ensure uninterrupted service.
title_cn: 总理下令紧急修复机场航线服务
summary_cn: 总理阿努廷·查恩瓦拉库尔（Anutin Charnvirakul）已下令泰国国家铁路公司（SRT）紧急解决机场快线存在的问题，确保服务不中断。该航线是往返曼谷素万纳普机场的重要交通枢纽，涉及大量游客和日常通勤者出行。
desc_original: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) to urgently resolve problems with the Airport Rail Link and ensure uninterrupted service.

title: Chinese tourism influx set to generate B11.5bn
desc: An estimated 250,000 Chinese tourists are expected to visit Thailand during a 13-day span including Golden Week and the Mid-Autumn Festival this year, generating 11.5 billion baht thanks to a weak baht against the yuan and new direct flights, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT).
title_cn: 中国游客潮预计为泰国创造115亿泰铢收益
summary_cn: 泰国旅游局预测，约25万中国游客将在包括国庆黄金周和中秋节的13天内访泰，预计产生115亿泰铢经济效益。此次游客激增得益于人民币升值使泰铢相对贬值，以及新开通的直飞航班增加了出行便利。
desc_original: An estimated 250,000 Chinese tourists are expected to visit Thailand during a 13-day span including Golden Week and the Mid-Autumn Festival this year, generating 11.5 billion baht thanks to a weak baht against the yuan and new direct flights, according to the Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT).

title: Auto sector eyes clarity on EV tax restructure
desc: The business sector supports automotive tax restructuring efforts, which aim to encourage genuine investment and production in Thailand while ensuring local auto parts manufacturers and small businesses benefit from the policy.
title_cn: 汽车业期待电动车税收改革政策明确
summary_cn: 泰国商业界支持汽车行业税收重组改革计划，旨在鼓励对泰国的真实投资和生产活动，确保本地汽车零件制造商和小型企业能从政策中受益。这一改革有利于推动泰国汽车产业升级和经济转型。
desc_original: The business sector supports automotive tax restructuring efforts, which aim to encourage genuine investment and production in Thailand while ensuring local auto parts manufacturers and small businesses benefit from the policy.

title: TransNusa launches Bali-Phuket flights with full first service
desc: TransNusa launches Bali-Phuket flights with full first service Legacy TransNusa’s first direct Bali to Phuket flight landed at Phuket International Airport at 2.35pm on September 9, full with 174 passengers. Flight 8B541 left I Gusti Ngurah Rai International Airport in Bali at 11.30am. The airline flies the route with a 174-seat Airbus A320-200, four times a week on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays. That adds about 700 seats a week from Bali to Thailand, and TransNusa says the service goes daily from October 3. Tourism Authority of Thailand governor Thapanee Kiatphaibool said the link advances the agency’s Airline Focus strategy and the government’s Ease of Travelling policy. It expands convenient air access within Southeast Asia. The route also creates new opportunities to attract Indonesian travellers to Phuket. TransNusa Group CEO Datuk Bernard Francis described the launch as bridging two world-class tourism capitals, according to The Phuket News. He said the connection would let travellers take in both Phuket and Bali on one itinerary. Arrivals from Indonesia reached 429,778 between January 1 and September 7 this year, according to TAT . title: JIC boss says temple wasn't targeted
desc: The director of the Thailand-Cambodia Joint Information Centre (JIC) has rejected Cambodia's allegation that Thailand attacked Preah Vihear Temple.
title_cn: JIC主任否认泰国针对普雷亚维哈寺
summary_cn: 泰柬联合信息中心（JIC）主任否认泰国攻击柬埔寨普雷亚维哈寺（Preah Vihear Temple）的指控。该古寺坐落在泰柬边境，长期以来是两国领土争议的焦点。此次否认回应了柬方最近提出的指控，反映出泰柬两国在历史文化遗产保护和边界问题上的持续分歧与外交紧张。
desc_original: The director of the Thailand-Cambodia Joint Information Centre (JIC) has rejected Cambodia's allegation that Thailand attacked Preah Vihear Temple.

title: Neglected facilities draw public scrutiny
desc: NAKHON RATCHASIMA: Residents of this northeastern province are questioning the management of state-funded projects after a public library and observatory costing nearly 90 million baht were closed and left to deteriorate for more than a decade.
title_cn: 呵叻公共设施长期闲置引发质疑
summary_cn: 那空叻差是府（Nakhon Ratchasima）东北部地区居民对政府资金管理提出质疑。耗资近9000万铢的公共图书馆与天文观测站在启用后不久即被关闭，放任十多年未使用，设施严重破损失修。该事件引发全民对公共事业项目规划、执行和长期维护机制的广泛关注与批评。
desc_original: NAKHON RATCHASIMA: Residents of this northeastern province are questioning the management of state-funded projects after a public library and observatory costing nearly 90 million baht were closed and left to deteriorate for more than a decade.

title: Training boosts logistics careers
desc: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat praised public-private cooperation in developing skilled logistics workers after 147 companies hired graduates of a government-supported training programme.
title_cn: 技能培训为物流业输送人才
summary_cn: 劳动部长朱拉蓬·阿莫维瓦特（Julapun Amornvivat）赞扬政府与企业的合作成果。由政府支持的物流技能培训项目顺利完成，有147家物流与运输公司录用结业学员，人才供给与产业需求实现有效对接。此举体现泰国在发展高素质劳动力、升级产业竞争力方面的努力。
desc_original: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat praised public-private cooperation in developing skilled logistics workers after 147 companies hired graduates of a government-supported training programme.

title: Capitalising on 'waterway belt'
desc: Every month, hundreds of containers carrying tissue paper leave southern China for Thailand, making their way by sea to Laem Chabang before the products eventually reach convenience stores, restaurants and households across the country.
title_cn: 海上贸易走廊推动物流业发展
summary_cn: 来自中国南方的纸浆纸张产品每月数百集装箱通过海路运往泰国林查邦港（Laem Chabang），依托该港口的物流网络流向全国。这条海上贸易通道强化了泰国与区域贸易伙伴的经济联系，促进了仓储、运输和配送等物流产业的发展，相关产品广泛供应零售便利店、餐饮企业和普通家庭。
desc_original: Every month, hundreds of containers carrying tissue paper leave southern China for Thailand, making their way by sea to Laem Chabang before the products eventually reach convenience stores, restaurants and households across the country.

title: Jewish cemetery faces probe
desc: The Interior Ministry has ordered an investigation into the company that owns a Jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao over potential links to nominee businesses and money laundering.
title_cn: 差春犹太公墓公司遭调查
summary_cn: 泰国内政部下令调查位于差春县（Chachoengsao）犹太公墓的经营公司。调查涉及该公司是否与名义商业（代理人公司）和洗钱活动存在隐蔽关联，属于金融犯罪与资产监管范畴。此事直接关系到在泰外国人特别是犹太籍侨民的合法权益与资产安全。
desc_original: The Interior Ministry has ordered an investigation into the company that owns a Jewish cemetery in Chachoengsao over potential links to nominee businesses and money laundering.

title: Witness says testimony was forced
desc: A witness in the Senate collusion case sought to retract his testimony, claiming he had been coerced into implicating the Bhumjaithai Party, according to a leaked document obtained by reporters yesterday.
title_cn: 证人称证词遭强迫
summary_cn: 参议院串联案证人要求撤回证词，声称遭强迫指证泰国前进党。泄露文件已被记者获得。
desc_original: A witness in the Senate collusion case sought to retract his testimony, claiming he had been coerced into implicating the Bhumjaithai Party, according to a leaked document obtained by reporters yesterday.

title: Global factors could curb recent momentum
desc: The Stock Exchange of Thailand struggled to gain momentum for much of August, as external factors and an uptick in foreign net selling pushed the SET index back below 1,600 points.
title_cn: 全球因素可能遏制涨势
summary_cn: 泰国股市交易所(SET)8月表现疲弱，受全球因素和外资净卖压，SET指数跌破1600点。外部经济环境对股市形成制约。
desc_original: The Stock Exchange of Thailand struggled to gain momentum for much of August, as external factors and an uptick in foreign net selling pushed the SET index back below 1,600 points.

title: Taking a closer look at the GI label
desc: Geographical indication (GI) certification is becoming an important policy tool to strengthen Thailand's agricultural sector. By linking local products to their geographic origins, quality and unique characteristics, GI certification helps elevate the reputation and value of these products.
title_cn: 地理标志认证助力农业发展
summary_cn: 地理标志(GI)认证正成为泰国强化农业的重要政策工具。通过将本地产品与其地理来源、品质和独特特征相关联，GI认证有助提升这些产品的声誉和市场价值。
desc_original: Geographical indication (GI) certification is becoming an important policy tool to strengthen Thailand's agricultural sector. By linking local products to their geographic origins, quality and unique characteristics, GI certification helps elevate the reputation and value of these products.

title_cn: 外资持有泰国房产激增 中国买家领跑市场
summary_cn: 泰国房地产市场吸引外资大量涌入，今年上半年公寓交易总额达13万亿泰铢，其中外资持有超2.8万亿泰铢，中国籍投资者居首。在现行49%外资持有上限约束下，外资通过合法渠道或借代理人名义购置房产的现象日益显著，成为监管关注焦点。

title: Expat left baffled by traditional Thai tea bag packaging
desc: Expat left baffled by traditional Thai tea bag packaging Legacy A foreigner living in Thailand sparked waves of laughter across local social media. This happened after he shared his chaotic first attempt at drinking traditional Thai iced tea from a classic paper bag setup. On September 10, the Facebook page Edo Eats Wrong posted photos detailing the messy misadventure. The expat ordered Thai iced tea to his home. Since he was unfamiliar with the mechanics of Thai drink stalls, he took the inner plastic bag out of its protective brown paper carrier. He then jammed a straw directly through the side of the plastic pouch. The orange beverage instantly erupted, soaking his desk and floor. In his post, he joked about cracking an impossible code. He noted that the vendor told him to poke the straw straight into the bag without untying the rubber band. While he followed the instruction to skip the rubber band, he missed the critical detail of leaving the plastic pouch inside the paper bag. Instead, he punctured only the top. He admitted the tea tasted delicious, though he found the experience slightly too messy. Because of this, he added that he plans to stick to plastic cups next time. Th
title_cn: 外籍人士被泰国冰茶包装「难倒」：一戳就洒满桌
summary_cn: 一名在泰外籍居民初次饮用传统泰式冰茶时，因不熟悉纸塑混合包装结构，将内层塑料袋拆出纸袋后直接戳吸管，导致茶水四溅。摊主随后告诉他应将塑料袋保持在纸袋内，仅在顶部戳孔。这段「文化碰撞」趣事在社交媒体引发热议，也提醒初到泰国的外籍人士留意当地饮品的特殊喝法。

desc: งานมหกรรมการค้าภาคบริการนานาชาติจีน ปี 2026 (China International Fair for Trade in Services: CIFTIS) ได้เปิดฉากขึ้นเมื่อวันที่ 9 กันยายน ณ สวนโส่วกัง กรุงปักกิ่ง โดยมี 90 ประเทศ (ภูมิภาค) และองค์กรระหว่างประเทศเข้าร่วมจัดนิทรรศการและกิจกรรมในนามของประเทศ (ภูมิภาค) หรือสำนักงานใหญ่ ขณะที่มีวิสาหกิจ 1,830 กว่าแห่งเข้าร่วมจัดแสดงแบบออฟไลน์ ในจำนวนนี้ มีวิสาหกิจ 473 แห่งติดฟอร์จูน โกลบอล 500 หรือเป็นวิสาหกิจชั้นนำของอุตสาหกรรม งาน CIFTIS ครั้งนี้ได้จัดการประชุมฟอรัมอย่างเป็นระบบเป็นครั้งแรก โดยแบ่งออกเป็น 4 หมวด ได้แก่ “การเปิดกว้างและการผสมผสาน ความร่วมมือแบบ win-win นวัตกรรมดิจิทัลและอัจฉริยะ การพัฒนาสีเขียว” พร้อมทั้งจัดชุดกิจกรรมอันยอดเยี่ยมจำนวน 74 รายการ แหล่งที่มา Ecns The post งานมหกรรมการค้าภาคบริการนานาชาติจีน ปี 2026 (CIFTIS) เปิดฉาก โดยมี 90 ประเทศ ภูมิภาค และองค์กรระหว่างประเทศเข้าร่วมจัดนิทรรศการและกิจกรรม appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会开幕 90国参展

title: 每年540亿泰铢的善款，泰国寺庙拿什么证明透明？
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 9月10日清晨，泰国大城府佛泰沙旺寺。66岁的前住持帕瓦奇拉扬在僧舍内被警方带走，一同被捕的还有寺内47岁的女性工作人员普尼亚维。据泰国中央调查局（CIB）调查，这名前住持涉嫌以寺庙名义开具超过20份捐款收据，将巨额善款据为己有——涉案金额超过9200万泰铢，部分资金被转给女性，案件还涉及洗钱指控。 这起案件，把泰国寺庙财务管理的老问题再次推到聚光灯下。据泰媒报道，泰国民众每年向全国各地寺庙捐款总额约达544.17亿泰铢，全国寺庙资产总价值超过1.35万亿泰铢。当巨额善款与监管漏洞同时浮现，真正值得追问的，已不只是“钱去了哪里”，更是“谁在看着这些钱”。 一座古寺的“糊涂账”：9200万泰铢公款去向成谜 据泰媒报道，帕瓦奇拉扬涉嫌在两年多时间内，以寺庙名义开具超过20份未经授权的捐款收据；佛牌等宗教物品销售所得亦未按规定存入寺庙账户，而是通过设立基金会转入个人账户。警方在其住所查获大量黄金与现金——其中黄金超过1090泰铢重量单位（约合16.5公斤），现金超过1亿泰铢，各类资产总值超过2亿泰铢。 被捕后，帕瓦奇拉扬已正式还俗。他否认挪用公款，但承认与普尼亚维持有两年恋情。目前两人已移送北标府第一区反腐败法院申请羁押，案件仍在进一步调查中。需要说明的是，泰媒各报道对查获金额的估算口径不一，最终应以官方调查结果为准。 数字背后的现实：每年540亿泰铢捐款，与1.35万亿泰铢资产 根据泰国国家发展管理研究院（NIDA）开展的“泰国寺庙财务管理研究项目”，泰国寺庙财务管理存在结构性难题：大量资金管理权集中于住持一人，部分寺庙缺乏标准化的会计制度与独立的监督机制。 按照现行规定，寺庙现金超过3000泰铢后，必须以寺庙名义存入银行，资金大多存放于储蓄账户与定期存款账户。但全国寺庙银行存款总额至今没有形成统一、完整的官方统计，也未系统化向公众公开。据泰国媒体2025年统计，全国寺庙银行存款总额约达4100亿泰铢，分布在超过3.9万个银行账户中——这笔巨额资金，绝大多数不受政府直接监管。 当大量资金由少数人负责管理，而捐款民众无法充分获取寺庙财务信息时，这一信息差便容易引发外界质疑，也为违规行为留下空间。 监管的裂缝：巨额资金为何能“隐形” 问题并不只存在于现金与存款。近期案件显示，部分资产以其他形式被藏匿——超过1090泰铢重量单位的黄金、超过1亿泰铢现金、总值超2亿泰铢的各类资产，被发现藏于僧侣住所。若没有相关部门介入调查，这些资产可能长期游离于寺庙财务账目体系之外。 更值得警惕的是资金流转的规模。在最新案件中，调查发现寺庙资金遭挪用超过9200万泰铢，部分资金被转给女性，相关账户资金流转规模高达3.85亿泰铢。如此巨额资金为何能持续流动，却没有触发足够的预警或内部审查机制？这已不只是个人行为问题，更指向寺庙内部财务监管机制的有效性。 堵漏进行时：新规
title_cn: 泰国寺庙每年 544 亿泰铢善款：透明监管如何保障？
summary_cn: 泰国一前住持涉嫌挪用寺庙善款 9200 多万泰铢。调查显示，民众每年向寺庙捐款超 544 亿泰铢，寺庙资产总值超 1.35 万亿泰铢。然而财务管理权力过度集中于住持一人，缺乏标准化会计制度和独立监督机制。寺庙银行存款高达 4100 亿泰铢，分散在数万个账户，大多不受政府监管。信息不对称导致捐款者无法了解资金去向，为违规行为留下空间。

title: Off-plan or completed condo in Thailand: which should you buy?
desc: Off-plan or completed condo in Thailand: which should you buy? Legacy Buying a condo in Thailand often comes down to two options. You buy off-plan while the project is still being built, usually with staged payments and the possibility of getting in at an earlier price, or you buy something completed and know exactly what you are paying for. There is no “right” answer, and what matters much more is what you need the condo to do once you have bought it, because a property meant to generate rental income next month is a very different purchase from one you are happy to hold for five or ten years. The mechanics of foreign ownership , transferring money into Thailand and the 49% foreign ownership quota deserve their own guide, so we will not repeat all of that here. For this comparison, the question is how much are you prepared to trade certainty now for a potentially better deal later? title_cn: 泰国公寓投资指南：期房与竣工房如何选择？
summary_cn: 购买泰国公寓有两条主要选择：期房购买价格便宜，采用分期付款，但需等待竣工且无法预先查看具体单位；竣工房价格相对较高，可立即入住并详细了解产权。选择应基于购买目标——若计划立即出租获利，竣工房更实际；若能承受等待并追求价格优势，期房可能更划算。无「最佳」答案，关键是理解自己的投资目标与风险承受度。

title: Tsutaya Bookstore sets October 20 opening for first Thai branch at One Bangkok
desc: Tsutaya Bookstore sets October 20 opening for first Thai branch at One Bangkok Legacy Japanese chain Tsutaya Bookstore will open its first Thailand branch at The Storeys zone of One Bangkok shopping mall on October 20. Some Thai people who grew up in the 1980s and 1990s may remember Tsutaya as a video and DVD rental store. Its parent company, Cultural Convenience Club (CCC), previously operated the rental business in Thailand from 2000 to 2017. CCC returned to Thailand this year with Tsutaya Bookstore rather than its former rental business. The bookstore chain has already expanded across Japan, Taiwan, China, Malaysia and Cambodia. The new Tsutaya Bookstore at One Bangkok is the result of a partnership between Tsutaya Bookstore Malaysia and Asia Books, the bookstore business under Berli Jucker (BJC). Photo via Prachachat The branch will span more than 1,000 square metres across two floors. Its design follows the concept of The Waves of Wisdom, focusing on simple, airy and natural elements that reflect Japanese design. title: Pathum Thani bank robber burns getaway car after 1.5m baht heist
desc: Pathum Thani bank robber burns getaway car after 1.5m baht heist Legacy A robber remains at large after stealing more than 1.5 million baht from a TTB bank in Khlong Luang district, Pathum Thani , yesterday, September 10. The Khlong Luang bank robbery was reported at around 3.55pm at a TTB branch near a roundabout in the Khlong Luang area. Officers from Khlong Luang Police Station said the suspect was about 170 centimetres tall and was wearing a balaclava, red shirt and gloves. He arrived at the bank in a grey Toyota Vios sedan. Photo via ThaiRath CCTV footage showed the robber entering the bank and turning the closed sign to face outwards. He then used an iron bar taken from his bag to jam the door shut. The suspect rushed to the counter and allegedly used a firearm to threaten employees and demand cash. He reportedly took 500,000 baht from the counter and a further one million baht from a safe. The suspect’s vehicle was later found burned out in a wasteland beside the inbound Phahonyothin Road. Police checks found that the registration plate on the vehicle was fake. title: Ex-teacher dies in Bangkok prison before child rape appeal ruling
desc: Ex-teacher dies in Bangkok prison before child rape appeal ruling Legacy A former teacher convicted in multiple child sex offence cases died at Bangkok Remand Prison before the Court of Appeal was due to deliver its ruling today, September 11. Pichai, whose surname was withheld, had been convicted of raping a child under 15 and taking the child away from a parent or guardian for indecent purposes. The Criminal Court sentenced him on March 27 to five years for each offence, but reduced both terms by half because he confessed, leaving a combined sentence of five years. The court refused to suspend the sentence, citing the victim’s young age, Pichai’s background as a former teacher and his previous sexual offence record. His sentence was also ordered to run consecutively with two earlier cases. One carried a prison term of one year and 15 days for offences involving a child aged over 15 but under 18, while another resulted in 10 years and 24 months for raping a child under 15. title: 泰国佛牌名僧被曝坐拥巨额资产！与女香客遭查扣2.15亿泰铢
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，9月11日，泰国中央调查局联合泰国反洗钱办公室及泰国国家佛教办公室召开新闻发布会，公布大城府普泰沙万寺（Wat Phutthaisawan）前住持阿提措法师（法名瓦吉拉亚）涉嫌挪用寺庙资金案的最新调查进展。警方在阿提措法师僧舍内查获现金1.38亿泰铢、银行存款2.9亿泰铢、总重超过1066铢的黄金等巨额财物；与其关系密切的47岁女香客普妮雅威虽无固定职业，名下却被查出土地、房产、车辆等巨额资产。 作为著名“Rian Nuea Duang”佛牌（又称“抬高地位牌”）以及 Jatukam Rammathep（泽度金）系列圣物的制作者，阿提措法师在泰国佛牌圈具有一定知名度。案件源于2026年7月15日警方接获的一封匿名举报信。举报人反映，时任普泰沙万寺住持的阿提措法师与47岁的普妮雅威存在不正当男女关系，并指出普妮雅威没有固定职业，但名下财产出现异常增加。警方随后展开调查核实，发现阿提措法师确与普妮雅威涉嫌发生性关系。按照佛教僧团戒律，此举属严重违反戒律的”波罗夷”罪，一旦触犯即自动失去僧侣身份，不再具备比丘资格。 9月10日，警方对位于大城府、巴吞他尼府、曼谷及武里南府的6处目标地点展开搜查及抓捕行动。其间，大城府国家佛教办公室与当地僧团管理机构共同介入，按照僧团戒律为阿提措法师办理还俗手续，使其正式脱离僧侣身份。警方依据逮捕令共拘捕两名嫌疑人——66岁的阿提措法师和47岁的普妮雅威。 调查人员根据举报信中涉及寺庙财务问题的线索进一步深入调查，发现阿提措法师在任期间曾以寺庙名义向购买、供奉佛教圣物的信众收取捐款、开具功德证书，但相关款项并未存入寺庙账户。初步调查显示，相关资金转账及功德证书记录涉及金额合计约1亿多泰铢，造成寺庙损失超过9200万泰铢。警方同时公开了此前媒体报道中提到的、发生在餐桌上的争议监控画面。 警方在调查普妮雅威的金融交易记录时还发现，过去1至2年间，尽管她没有固定收入，名下资产却出现异常增长：2套总价值超过400万泰铢的联排别墅、1辆丰田Fortuner SUV、银行存款超过500万泰铢。调查还发现，为掩饰实际持有情况，部分资产登记在其女儿名下。警方认为，上述情况有理由怀疑普妮雅威与阿提措法师存在串谋洗钱行为，并因此给普泰沙万寺造成损失。 发布会上，警方通报了搜查中查扣的主要涉案财物。阿提措法师方面，警方在其僧舍内查获：银行账户存款超过2.9亿泰铢；现金138,308,986泰铢；总重量超过1066铢、价值约7000万泰铢的金条及黄金饰品，其中现金及黄金查获总价值为205,204,733泰铢。 普妮雅威方面，警方在其住所内查获现金3,873,614泰铢、黄金约90铢（价值约6,151,500泰铢），查获财物总价值10,025,114泰铢；此外还查获土地及银行账户相关文件10项（土地地契2
title_cn: 泰国名僧坐拥巨资涉洗钱 与女信徒共被查扣2.15亿泰铢
summary_cn: 大城府普泰沙万寺（Wat Phutthaisawan）前住持阿提措法师因挪用寺庙资金遭调查。该僧曾因制作著名「抬高地位牌」等佛牌在佛教圈知名。7月警方接举报，称其与47岁女信徒普妮雅威有不正当关系且资产异常增加。9月10日警方展开搜查，发现阿提措以寺庙名义募集捐款未入寺账，造成寺庙损失超9200万泰铢。其僧舍查获现金1.38亿泰铢及巨额黄金，普妮雅威名下有多套房产和豪车。警方怀疑两人串谋洗钱。
desc_original: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，9月11日，泰国中央调查局联合泰国反洗钱办公室及泰国国家佛教办公室召开新闻发布会，公布大城府普泰沙万寺（Wat Phutthaisawan）前住持阿提措法师（法名瓦吉拉亚）涉嫌挪用寺庙资金案的最新调查进展。警方在阿提措法师僧舍内查获现金1.38亿泰铢、银行存款2.9亿泰铢、总重超过1066铢的黄金等巨额财物；与其关系密切的47岁女香客普妮雅威虽无固定职业，名下却被查出土地、房产、车辆等巨额资产。 作为著名“Rian Nuea Duang”佛牌（又称“抬高地位牌”）以及 Jatukam Rammathep（泽度金）系列圣物的制作者，阿提措法师在泰国佛牌圈具有一定知名度。案件源于2026年7月15日警方接获的一封匿名举报信。举报人反映，时任普泰沙万寺住持的阿提措法师与47岁的普妮雅威存在不正当男女关系，并指出普妮雅威没有固定职业，但名下财产出现异常增加。警方随后展开调查核实，发现阿提措法师确与普妮雅威涉嫌发生性关系。按照佛教僧团戒律，此举属严重违反戒律的”波罗夷”罪，一旦触犯即自动失去僧侣身份，不再具备比丘资格。 9月10日，警方对位于大城府、巴吞他尼府、曼谷及武里南府的6处目标地点展开搜查及抓捕行动。其间，大城府国家佛教办公室与当地僧团管理机构共同介入，按照僧团戒律为阿提措法师办理还俗手续，使其正式脱离僧侣身份。警方依据逮捕令共拘捕两名嫌疑人——66岁的阿提措法师和47岁的普妮雅威。 调查人员根据举报信中涉及寺庙财务问题的线索进一步深入调查，发现阿提措法师在任期间曾以寺庙名义向购买、供奉佛教圣物的信众收取捐款、开具功德证书，但相关款项并未存入寺庙账户。初步调查显示，相关资金转账及功德证书记录涉及金额合计约1亿多泰铢，造成寺庙损失超过9200万泰铢。警方同时公开了此前媒体报道中提到的、发生在餐桌上的争议监控画面。 警方在调查普妮雅威的金融交易记录时还发现，过去1至2年间，尽管她没有固定收入，名下资产却出现异常增长：2套总价值超过400万泰铢的联排别墅、1辆丰田Fortuner SUV、银行存款超过500万泰铢。调查还发现，为掩饰实际持有情况，部分资产登记在其女儿名下。警方认为，上述情况有理由怀疑普妮雅威与阿提措法师存在串谋洗钱行为，并因此给普泰沙万寺造成损失。 发布会上，警方通报了搜查中查扣的主要涉案财物。阿提措法师方面，警方在其僧舍内查获：银行账户存款超过2.9亿泰铢；现金138,308,986泰铢；总重量超过1066铢、价值约7000万泰铢的金条及黄金饰品，其中现金及黄金查获总价值为205,204,733泰铢。 普妮雅威方面，警方在其住所内查获现金3,873,614泰铢、黄金约90铢（价值约6,151,500泰铢），查获财物总价值10,025,114泰铢；此外还查获土地及银行账户相关文件10项（土地地契2

title: EEC新城重整规划，预计吸引1.34万亿投资
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 ，据泰国媒体报道，9月8日，泰国内阁召开会议，批准重新审议此前与2022年3月22日通过的关于东部经济走廊（EEC）商业中心及宜居智慧新城项目的决议，将项目范围由原先约14619莱调整至约14586莱，旨在进一步满足投资者需求，提升区域经济竞争力。 东部经济走廊政策委员会办公室表示，此次调整针对土地及整体开发模式进行优化。其中，土地将重新划分为大型正方形及长方形地块，为高科技产业投资者在建筑设计、园区规划及未来扩建方面提供便利。 项目开发模式也将由原先的线性开发转为集中式开发，以提高基础设施利用效率，同时降低建设成本以及运营和维护成本。此外，项目将充分利用现有高压输电网络，进一步完善交通运输及公共交通系统之间的衔接。 在产业布局方面，EEC宜居智慧新城将重点承接生物—循环—绿色经济（BCG）产业，推动清洁能源创新，支持泰国实现碳中和及可持续发展目标。 EEC新城定位为与曼谷并行发展的商业城市，目标在2037年前跻身全球十大宜居智慧城市。 据预计，项目未来10年总投资规模将达到约1.34万亿泰铢，其中私营部门投资占87.5%，政府与私营部门合作占9.7%，政府投资占2.8%。 其中，基础设施及中央智能公共设施将通过政企合作模式引入私营部门投资，共涉及清洁能源、供水、污水处理、垃圾处理、数字基础设施及交通运输等10个系统，预计投资约720.42亿泰铢。 经济效益方面，EEC新城预计将在10年开发周期内为泰国带来超过2万亿泰铢的GDP增长价值，同时规划最高可容纳35万人，预计直接创造超过20万个就业岗位。 （编译：jinda；审校：wan；来源：bangkokbiznews） The post EEC新城重整规划，预计吸引1.34万亿投资 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 东部经济走廊（EEC）新城规划调整，预计吸引1.34万亿泰铢投资
summary_cn: 泰国政府批准调整东部经济走廊（EEC）智慧新城项目。项目范围微调至14586莱，开发模式由线性改为集中式，以提高基础设施利用效率、降低成本。土地将重新划分为不同规格地块，便于高科技产业投资。项目将重点发展生物-循环-绿色（BCG）经济和清洁能源产业。预计10年内总投资1.34万亿泰铢（私营部门占87.5%），为国家创造GDP增长2万亿泰铢，直接创造超20万个就业机会。项目定位为与曼谷并行的国际城市，目标2037年进入全球十大宜居智慧城市。

title: 泰美妆零售巨头EVEANDBOY进军资本市场 瞄准100亿泰铢营收
desc: 泰国头条新闻社讯 据泰媒报道，泰国大型美妆零售商“EVEANDBOY”正式迈向资本市场，已于9月10日向泰国证券交易所提交首次公开募股（IPO）申请，拟使用股票简称“EB”，由卡西孔担任财务顾问，为公司未来在泰国证券交易所上市铺路。 EVEANDBOY公司主要经营多品牌美妆及健康产品零售业务，通过实体门店和线上渠道销售。目前，公司在泰国各地约有70家门店，并计划继续扩大门店规模。此次提交股票发行申请，标志着EVEANDBOY正式启动上市进程。下一阶段，公司仍需经过申请文件、股票发行及股票在泰国证券交易所上市交易等相关审核和批准程序。目前，公司尚未公布拟发行股票数量、IPO价格及融资规模。 在进入资本市场之前，EVEANDBOY业绩已持续增长。2024年公司营收为44.2571亿泰铢，利润为11.0151亿泰铢；2025年营收增至53.3927亿泰铢，利润为12.1875亿泰铢；2026年上半年营收为27.6252亿泰铢，利润为5.9798亿泰铢。 在业务发展目标方面，公司计划通过扩大门店规模进一步加快增长，并计划较原定时间更早实现100亿泰铢营收目标。公司认为，尽管整体经济面临消费能力、商品成本以及国际经济形势等因素带来的压力，美妆产品市场仍具有增长空间。 EVEANDBOY首席执行官希兰表示，美妆市场仍是保持增长的产品领域之一，尤其年轻消费者依然重视个人护理和形象。同时，消费者行为正在发生变化，从过去较为依赖某一特定品牌，逐渐转向根据自身问题和具体需求选择产品。 除增加门店数量外，EVEANDBOY还计划调整业务模式，从传统化妆品零售店向“Beauty Destination”转型，并通过建设体验店为消费者打造新的购物体验，包括设置工作坊空间、活动空间和Pop-up Store，同时开发融合生活方式与美妆元素的门店概念。与此同时，公司还持续为泰国本土美妆品牌及新兴品牌提供进入市场的空间，这与“T-Beauty”市场的发展趋势相契合。近年来，越来越多泰国本土品牌销售额不断增长，并逐步具备与国际品牌竞争的能力。 （编译：hansa；审核：wan；来源：thansettakij） The post 泰美妆零售巨头EVEANDBOY进军资本市场 瞄准100亿泰铢营收 appeared first on 泰国头条新闻 .
title_cn: 泰国美妆零售商EVEANDBOY正式启动首次公开募股
summary_cn: 泰国美妆零售商EVEANDBOY于9月10日向泰国证券交易所正式提交首次公开募股（IPO）申请，股票简称「EB」。公司在泰国各地拥有70家门店，近年业绩增长迅速，2024年营收44.26亿、2025年53.39亿泰铢。公司计划通过扩大门店规模，提前实现100亿泰铢年营收目标。同时从传统化妆品零售店转型为「Beauty Destination」体验中心，设置工作坊和Pop-up Store，重点扶持泰国本土品牌。
